vagas.title: Instrutor de Formação Profissional - Automação e Eletroeletrônica
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Instrutor de Formação Profissional - Automação e Eletroeletrônica em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Descrição  O SENAI – SP está em busca de profissionais para formação de Banco de Talentos  para o Estado de São Paulo. Se você é da área de Automação e Eletroeletrônica  e tem habilidade para compartilhar o seu conhecimento, inscreva-se e venha transformar o futuro da educação e da indústria com a gente!  O que o INSTRUTOR DE FORMAÇÃO PROFISSIONAL  do SENAI SP  irá fazer:  Planejar e preparar instruções e atividades dos cursos de formação e habilitação profissional, abordando conhecimentos tecnológicos e execução de práticas operacionais em equipamentos e instrumentos de tecnologia avançada. Preparar os ambientes de ensino e materiais a serem utilizados no desenvolvimento do curso. Aplicar instrumentos de avaliação na verificação do aproveitamento e do grau de desempenho no processo de ensino aprendizagem. Executar serviços e instruir equipes em assessorias empresariais.  Na área de Automação  poderá atuar em:   Comandos Eletrohidráulicos:   Comandos Eletropneumáticos   Domótica - Automação predial   Instrumentação - Controle Automático de Processos   Projetos de Sistemas Integrados CAD/CAM/CAE   Mecatrônica - Sistemas Flexíveis De Manufatura     Na área de Eletroeletrônica  poderá atuar em:   Controle e Automação Industrial   Eletrotécnica   Eletrônica   Energias Renováveis   Instalação e Manutenção Elétrica de Baixa Tensão   Manutenção Eletroeletrônica   Máquinas Elétricas e Acionamentos   Redes de Distribuição em média e Alta Tensão   Sistemas de Controle de Processos e Redes Industriais   Sistemas Microcontrolados e Microprocessados     Local de Trabalho: Unidade SENAI SP –  Acesse aqui e confira as cidades disponíveis.  A modalidade de contratação e Carga horária será definida no momento da admissão, de acordo com a necessidade do SENAI.   Requisitos  O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ NO DIA A DIA – CONFORME A ÁREA DE ATUAÇÃO:   Automação   Comandos Eletrohidráulicos:   Princípios físicos da hidráulica; mecânica dos fluidos; bombas hidráulicas; atuadores hidráulicos; válvulas direcionais, préoperadoras, de retenção e de fluxo; circuitos hidráulicos; fluidos hidráulicos; acumuladores hidráulicos; técnicas de comando eletrohidráulico; elementos de sinais elétricos em circuitos eletrohidráulicos; processamento de sinais elétricos em circuitos eletrohidráulicos; eletroválvulas hidráulicas; válvulas hidráulicas proporcionais; projetos de circuitos eletrohidráulicos; análise de defeitos em circuitos eletrohidráulicos; softwares específicos para comandos eletrohidráulicos; tecnologias da informação e comunicação (TIC) aplicadas à atividade docente; normas técnicas NBR 5410 e NR 10; higiene e segurança do trabalho, incluindo proteção de máquinas e uso de EPIs; gestão da qualidade e gestão ambiental; domínio de aplicativos de escritório; domínio da elaboração de planilhas e dashboards.  Comandos Eletropneumáticos   Mecânica dos fluidos; propriedades do ar comprimido; dispositivos de comando pneumático; dispositivos e circuitos de acionamento pneumático; análise de defeitos em circuitos pneumáticos; dispositivos de comando elétrico; dispositivos e circuitos de acionamento elétrico; diagramas elétricos; análise de defeitos em circuitos elétricos; dispositivos de comando eletropneumático; dispositivos e circuitos de acionamento eletropneumático; comandos sequenciais eletropneumáticos; projetos de circuitos eletropneumáticos; análise de defeitos em comandos eletropneumáticos; softwares específicos para comandos eletropneumáticos; tecnologias da informação e comunicação (TIC) aplicadas à atividade docente; normas NBR 5410 e NR 10; higiene e segurança do trabalho com proteção de máquinas e EPIs; gestão da qualidade e gestão ambiental; domínio de aplicativos de escritório; domínio da elaboração de planilhas e dashboards.  Domótica - Automação predial   Instalação e configuração de sistemas de automação residencial (iluminação, temperatura, eletrodomésticos, persianas e similares); integração de dispositivos inteligentes (assistentes virtuais, sistemas de áudio/vídeo etc.); domínio de protocolos de comunicação (WiFi, Zigbee, ZWave e outros); instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas de CFTV (câmeras, DVR/NVR, softwares de monitoramento e análise); tipos e características de câmeras (IP, analógicas, infravermelho etc.); instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas de detecção e alarme de incêndio; normas de segurança contra incêndio; sistemas de cerca elétrica (centrais, eletrificadores, sensores e painéis); normas de segurança para cercas elétricas; instalação, configuração e manutenção de portões automáticos (motores, centrais, sensores e sistemas de segurança); tipos de portões e seus sistemas de controle; sistemas de controle de acesso (fechaduras eletrônicas, catracas); sistemas de interfonia e videoporteiro; informática básica (Windows, Excel e PowerPoint); conexões elétricas; cabeamento, protocolos e redes de comunicação; operação de controladores programáveis.  Instrumentação - Controle Automático de Processos   Medição de variáveis de processo (nível, vazão, pressão, temperatura etc.); elementos finais de controle; sistemas analógicos e digitais; controle automático de processos; controladores lógicos programáveis; redes industriais; integração de sistemas digitais; informática aplicada ao controle de processos; princípios de gestão da qualidade e gestão ambiental; softwares de supervisão; segurança do trabalho; domínio de aplicativos de escritório; elaboração de planilhas e dashboards.  Projetos de Sistemas Integrados CAD/CAM/CAE   Modelamento tridimensional em CAD; comandos básicos e avançados para modelamento 3D; modelamento em superfície; modelamento híbrido (sólido + superfície); análise de curvas e superfícies; engenharia reversa; criação de modelos em CAD a partir de nuvem de pontos; manipulação de conjuntos mecânicos; geração de programas em CAM; pósprocessamento, simulação e manufatura; conceitos de CAE; análise matricial de elementos finitos; elementos mola, treliça, viga e sólidos tridimensionais; softwares específicos para projetos integrados CAD/CAM/CAE; tecnologias da informação e comunicação aplicadas à docência; higiene e segurança do trabalho com proteção de máquinas e EPIs; gestão da qualidade e gestão ambiental; domínio de aplicativos de escritório; domínio da elaboração de planilhas e dashboards.  Mecatrônica - Sistemas Flexíveis De Manufatura   Robôs industriais; Elementos de transporte (esteiras); Dispositivos de controle de qualidade; Dispositivos de montagem; Integração (hardware e software) de robôs, CNC e outros elementos e dispositivos; About You You excel at navigating complex Enterprise organizations with stakeholders across different levels of seniority and including both technical stakeholders in an organization (e.g. Principal Engineers, Data Scientists) as well as business stakeholders (e.g. Risk Managers, Credit Analysts).  You have 3+ years of hands-on experience writing production Python code  You are curious and customer-centric. You enjoy learning about our customers’ and prospects’ businesses and helping them solve challenges.  You are able to plan and manage the technical scope of Proof of Concepts (POCs) and technical evaluations. You excel at managing multiple high-stakes prospects simultaneously while partnering with Sales to drive deals to close  You are humble and have a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new skills and methodologies and bring best practices into our business.  You are collaborative and work well with your peers in Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering and the Customer Success team.  You have a proven track record of supporting high-contract-value enterprise deals. You understand that winning an enterprise deal requires more than just good code—it requires strategic positioning, deep discovery, and the ability to handle complex technical objections.   What You'll Do You discover and translate customer\'s strategic priorities and problem statements into high impact Agentic AI use cases leveraging Taktile during the sales process and throughout the Enterprise sales cycle, focusing on uncovering high-value AI use cases that justify significant investment and strategic partnership.  You lead the design and execution of proof-of-value projects that combine customer data, ML/AI models, and Taktile’s platform to demonstrate strategic ROI. You build technical prototypes and demos leveraging the Taktile platform that simulate production-grade integrations and workflows.  You collaborate with partners and customers to design and build solutions in Taktile\'s Agentic Decisioning Platform.  You lead proof-of-value projects and can communicate the value opportunity of a full implementation and the corresponding strategic roadmap to senior stakeholders up to C-level executives.  You work with product management to share competitive intelligence and prospect insights gathered during the sales process, helping shape Taktile\'s AI product roadmap and positioning strategy.  You create re-usable collateral, best practices & tools to help scale your knowledge and expertise across the solution engineering function.  You lead the discovery for new use cases and implement them on the platform to assess product-solution fit. You provide feedback to our product team and share results of your discovery with go to market functions.   Ideal, But Not Required Live for Customer Value: You have at least 3-5 years of experience working within Enterprise Solution/ Sales Engineering in B2B SaaS, or in a senior technical consulting role  Technical expertise: You have a general understanding of REST APIs (design, integration, authentication)  You have experience building, tuning, or deploying ML models (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow) in production settings  Experience with AI use cases in financial services (e.g. fraud detection, credit scoring, underwriting) is a strong plus.  You are comfortable explaining how a model works to both a technical stakeholder such as a CTO and domain experts such as Credit Risk Managers  You have acquired domain expertise in the financial services industry (banking, insurance, capital markets, payments, etc.).   Our Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you\'ll find yourself at home here  Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company  Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo  Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.  Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package  Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.  Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.   Our Stance We\'re eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We\'re looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply  We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won\'t inquire about how you identify or if you\'ve experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears   About Us Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams the tools to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control. By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve. Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry. We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast-growing startups and enterprise leaders. Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Index Ventures, Balderton Capital, and Tiger Global, along with the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath - we’re building a world-class organization across all functions and levels to power the next generation of AI-driven decision-making in financial services.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão  Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.  Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento.  Nossos esforços nessa agenda nos renderam o prestigioso Prêmio Catalyst e a Certificação Fair Pay Leader 2025, reconhecimento pelo nosso compromisso com a equidade salarial, refletido em uma diferença de gênero global de apenas 0,52%.  #DesperteSuasPossibilidades #UmaXícaradeMomentosIncríveis  Descrição da empresa  Quem somos nós?   Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.  A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.  No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.  Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?   Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de café e chá. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar um impacto positivo no mundo do café e do chá.  Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá. Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal.  Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café ou chá.  Inscreva-se para experimentar uma xícara de momentos incríveis em sua carreira. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of experienced candidates across coaching, marketing, operations, and leadership functions.  Support efforts to attract diverse talent that aligns with the organization's mission and values, with particular attention to U.S. labor market dynamics.  Collaborate, when needed, with pre‑approved external recruiting partners to support specialized or hard‑to‑fill searches.    Onboarding and employee experience   Lead the design and execution of a structured onboarding experience for U.S. and international hires, ensuring clarity on expectations, tools, and culture.  Continuously refine the new‑hire journey to reflect the organization's brand, values, and distributed, often remote, workforce.  Partner with leaders to foster strong cross‑functional communication and collaboration across time zones and locations.  Support and help design engagement initiatives, team development activities, and culture‑building practices.    Compensation, benefits, and HR operations   Oversee HR operations for U.S. employees, including payroll changes, employee records, and HR platforms, with a focus on accuracy and confidentiality.  Partner with leadership to develop and refine compensation strategies, conduct U.S. market benchmarking, and build transparent salary bands.  Manage PTO/FTO tracking, leave administration, and compliance with multi‑state U.S. employment requirements, while also considering international contexts where applicable.  Maintain and improve HR systems, documentation, and SOPs that support scale and clarity. Coach leaders on addressing performance gaps, and support the creation of development plans and performance improvement plans where needed.  Help define and refine career paths across coaching and operational teams, with clear expectations and progression criteria.  Promote a culture of accountability, feedback, and clear ownership across the organization. Manage sensitive issues with discretion, consistency, and fairness, balancing individual needs and organizational priorities.  Advise leadership on communication approaches, change management, and practices that reduce friction and misalignment.    Compliance and risk management   Ensure HR practices align with applicable federal, state, and local U.S. employment regulations, and coordinate on international compliance as needed.  Own the ongoing maintenance of employee handbooks, policies, and documentation, ensuring alignment with legal requirements and organizational values.  Lead and document investigations, corrective actions, and HR‑related risk mitigation with professionalism and attention to detail.    Organizational development and scaling   Design and refine scalable HR processes that support continued growth, including in the U.S. and global markets.  Provide people‑related insights and data to inform decisions about structure, headcount planning, and cultural impact.    Requirements   7+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, People Operations, or a similar field, with substantial U.S.-based experience.  Background in high‑growth, entrepreneurial, or service‑based organizations.  Deep understanding of U.S. employment law, including multi‑state compliance; international HR experience is a plus.  Demonstrated track record of building and scaling HR processes and programs from the ground up.  Strong communication, facilitation, active listening, and conflict‑resolution skills, including with senior stakeholders.  High level of confidentiality, integrity, and emotional intelligence.  Ability to balance empathy with accountability, clear expectations, and data‑informed decision‑making.  Proficiency with HRIS systems and modern project management tools; experience with Asana or similar platforms is preferred. Aqui você pode ter uma experiência completa de conexão e conhecimento sobre os animais e o bioma, um patrimônio natural de importância global.  Realizar atividades manutenção, limpeza e conservação, contribuindo para que os recintos, equipamentos e materiais estejam limpos, o ambiente organizado, as estruturas íntegras e realizar demais atividades necessárias para o bem-estar dos animais;  Monitorar as condições físicas e comportamentais dos animais, comunicando a equipe e superior imediato qualquer intercorrência que possa prejudicar a saúde e bem-estar dos animais;  Realizar vistoria nos recintos e ninhos para identificar qualquer situação que possa comprometer o bem-estar dos animais, como possíveis predadores, animais não habilitados para o ambiente (serpentes, roedores e afins), com posterior realização de medidas necessárias, conforme orientação do superior imediato;  Conferir a quantidade de animais em cada recinto, seguindo os protocolos definidos;  Realizar manejos agendados ou emergenciais para contenção física, conforme estabelecido em protocolos que visem movimentação de animais, incluindo recebimento e/ou destinação para instituições externas;  Contribuir para a execução de processos de certificação e/ou acreditação relacionados às atividades de manejo animal;  Coletar materiais e realizar ambientação de recintos, bem como oferecer vegetações e substratos, conforme orientação do superior imediato;  Contribuir com o oferecimento pontual de itens de enriquecimento ambiental, em parceria com as áreas responsáveis, realizando observações comportamentais sempre que necessário;  Comunicar imediatamente à equipe e superior imediato qualquer intercorrência/alterações relacionadas aos animais, a estrutura, equipamentos, materiais e falta de insumos;  Realizar encaminhamentos imediatos de animais apáticos e/ou doentes para a área responsável;  Acompanhar as interações dos animais com os visitantes no ambiente do Parque das Aves, fazendo as interações e atendendo as ocorrências quando necessário e conforme orientação do superior imediato;  Realizar o controle de temperatura e umidade dos recintos, registrando as informações em documento específico, conforme orientação;  Utilizar materiais e recursos apropriados na execução das tarefas zelando pela segurança física e sanitária, obedecendo os procedimentos específicos adquiridos em treinamentos para o seu uso;  Cuidar dos materiais utilizados, bem como organizar e limpar o local de trabalho, removendo resíduos, lixo e material para descarte;  Executar os protocolos de segurança e de comunicação determinados institucionalmente;  Realizar atividades com animais em todas as dependências do Parque das Aves seguindo protocolos sanitários estabelecidos pela a área responsável;  Participar do rodízio de sobreaviso conforme escala, seguindo o protocolo institucional, atendendo os chamados e se deslocando imediatamente ao Parque das Aves;  Realizar as atividades sob sua responsabilidade, utilizando equipamento de proteção individual e de proteção coletiva;  Contribuir com a recepção de estagiários compartilhando os conhecimentos adquiridos e a rotina de atividades;  Prestar suporte ao gestor e à equipe e realizar outras atividades relacionadas.    Requisitos   Desejável cursos para atividades em altura (NR 35);  Carteira de motorista - categoria B  Desejável experiência em manejo de animais em zoológicos, criadouros ou empreendimentos relacionados. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós. A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio. A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor. Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange. This is a dynamic advisory position that puts you at the forefront of leveraging Zendesk's cutting-edge AI technologies to guide customers directly to their desired business outcomes. You will gain full ownership of your customer relationships, acting as an orchestrator and strategic partner, responsible for driving product adoption, articulating clear ROI, and accelerating growth. If you are driven by accountability, have a strong technical understanding of SaaS/AI, and want to make an outsized impact on customer success and Zendesk's growth trajectory, this role offers the perfect platform for innovation and career acceleration.## **Overarching Objective for the role:*** Proactive customer health management through intentional, outcome-driven customer engagement, leveraging Zendesk’s advanced solutions, including cutting-edge AI technologies.* Product adoption acceleration and value realization, acting as an evangelist for Zendesk’s AI and automation capabilities, partnering with customers to articulate ROI and provide tailored adoption roadmaps.* Cultivating, strengthening, and accelerating growth of Zendesk customer relationships by applying technical understanding of Zendesk’s products and AI capabilities to advise customers on solution fit, configuration, and integration.## **How You’ll Make an Impact*** Take full ownership of customer relationships, proactively managing their success throughout the entire lifecycle—from onboarding and outcome realization to renewal. You will be accountable for customer health, retention, and advocacy, always seeking new ways to add value.* Deliver outcome-driven engagement across each stage of the customer journey by leveraging customer experience (CX) management best practices. You’ll design and execute success plans, coordinate onboarding with Professional Services, and continuously optimize the customer experience.* Champion product adoption and value realization, acting as an evangelist for Zendesk’s AI and automation capabilities. You will partner with customers to articulate ROI, provide tailored adoption roadmaps, and celebrate success.* Apply your technical understanding of Zendesk’s products and AI capabilities to advise customers on solution fit, configuration, and integration. You’ll serve as a knowledgeable guide for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating features into real-world value.* Identify commercial opportunities within your accounts by maintaining commercial acumen—spotting whitespace for expansion, leading renewals based on demonstrated business impact, and driving revenue growth through strategic engagement.* Use analytical capability to interpret customer data and health metrics, proactively uncover trends, and make informed recommendations. You’ll prioritize accounts, forecast renewals, and surface risks and opportunities using data-driven insights.* Build strategic partnerships with customers by operating as a trusted advisor. You’ll facilitate long-term success planning, foster executive relationships, and collaborate cross-functionally to align on mutual goals and innovation.**What You’ll Need to Succeed**## **Customer Focus & Ownership*** Proven track record of taking customer ownership: demonstrating accountability for outcomes and proactively driving customer value across the relationship.* Experience in CX management, orchestrating seamless end-to-end experiences, gathering and applying feedback, and working toward continuous improvement.## **Business Acumen & Strategy*** Business-oriented mindset with commercial acumen: able to understand customer business models, identify opportunities for growth, and connect product adoption to revenue drivers.* Ability to form strategic partnerships—developing deep, consultative relationships, co-developing success plans, and serving as an innovation partner.### **Technical & Product Expertise*** Strong technical understanding—comfortable learning new technologies and quickly grasping Zendesk’s advanced AI features, integrations, and scalability.* Natural adoption and value evangelist who passionately champions Zendesk’s full potential, coaches stakeholders on new capabilities, and communicates impact to drive both engagement and retention.### **Data & Analytical Skills*** Analytical capability: skilled in interpreting customer usage data, monitoring health scores, quantifying impact of adoption, and prioritizing actions based on analysis.### ## This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.**The intelligent heart of customer experience**Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código e trabalho colaborativo.  Familiaridade com ferramentas como Figma para consultar especificações de layout e estilo de interfaces.  Disposição para evolução constante e aprendizado de novas tecnologias.    Desejáveis   Experiência com TypeScript em projetos React.  Experiência com bibliotecas de componentes UI como Material UI e Styled Components.  Familiaridade com bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado, como React Context, Redux ou similares.  Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando ferramentas como Vitest ou Jest.  Conhecimento em bibliotecas de visualização de dados como D3, Highcharts, Plotly ou similares.  Noções de deploy de aplicações front-end em ambientes de nuvem, como Vercel, AWS ou Google Cloud. Experiência com CI/CD pipelines, especialmente em ambientes que utilizam GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares. vagas.title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Engineering Manager, MAAS em espumoso. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Overview  Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.  We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.  The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.  Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.  Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.  The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.  Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.  What we are looking for in you   Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science  Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university  Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages  Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)  Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S  Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems  Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills  Experience with agile software development methodologies  Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members  Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments  Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long    Nice-to-have skills   Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue  Data Center infrastructure management and design    What we offer colleagues  We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.   Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!  Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year  Annual compensation review  Recognition rewards  Annual holiday leave  Maternity and paternity leave  Employee Assistance Programme  Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues  Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events    About Canonical  Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.  Canonical is an equal opportunity employer  We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

About Thorogood Thorogood is an independent, specialized, Data & AI consulting firm that works with some of the biggest and best-known companies around the world. We have offices in London, Philadelphia, Boston, Singapore, São Paulo, and Bangalore, and we work as a global unit to service blue chip customers drawing from data-rich sectors such as consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, insurance, and financial services sectors. Together, we compete on the basis of our specialism, our people, high quality, and assured delivery. We help our customers leverage the latest technologies to make timely, data-driven business decisions. Our multi-skilled teams understand the critical interplay of data engineering, data science, and data visualization. We work across these areas to create business-focused, end-to-end technology solutions robust enough to meet enterprise needs. We recognize the importance of environmental sustainability, both in how we work and in the solutions we build for our clients. Our services span strategy, implementation, advanced analytics services, user empowerment, and support. About the Position Overview Our team members are expected to have a strong interest in business. Understanding our clients’ organizations and industries is key to identifying areas of opportunity for us to help. Similarly, our people must have excellent listening, writing, and presenting skills, alongside the aptitude and motivation to master multiple data-focused technologies in a fast-moving field. This combination of business, people, and technical skills is essential. Our Brazil and US entities are managed together under one Thorogood Americas in support of development of our business in the region. Further, we work with colleagues across the US, UK, India, Singapore, and Brazil, and with global customers, to provide effective solutions. The ability to work collaboratively and effectively as part of a distributed team is imperative. Our most successful consultants develop a well-rounded set of skills in each of these areas of business, people, and technology. You’ll do so via a number of opportunities: Comprehensive training: During your first months at Thorogood, experienced consultants will introduce you to the technologies we work with, the industries we serve, and the ways in which we develop our business. Crucially, we will share how we live our values. When you’ve finished, we’ll plan to integrate you into both internal and client project initiatives. Building your core technology skills: We’re the kind of people who learn best by doing. You’ll be working on a team locked onto business value for the customer to develop fast, effective, and high-quality technical solutions. Working with top clients: Thorogood works with some of the biggest and best-known companies in the world. You’ll be a part of client interactions, sometimes leading them, to make sure we’re keeping our projects on track and delivering value to our customers. Developing relationships: We consider ourselves trusted advisors for our clients. We earn this trust through listening carefully, sharing the expertise we have acquired, and helping to progress the objectives within their organizations. Shaping future projects: We are always listening to customers to understand their objectives and needs and working with our consultants to share proposals on how we can help. Working as part of a supportive project team: You’ll be working from our offices, with occasional travel internally or externally to client sites. Your project teams will comprise consultants across many levels of experience, working together daily to support one another along the way. Becoming an expert, yourself: Our subject matter experts are not necessarily the most tenured people at Thorogood. In the rapidly changing world of Data & AI, we look to all levels of experience to gain expertise in new technologies and analytical techniques.  In addition to project work, Thorogood consultants run our company, thus it’s expected from them: Help to grow our business: Interact with current and prospective clients, listen to their needs, and drive business development activities and discussions. Together, we’ll consider the business objectives in conjunction with the technical possibilities in order to understand the opportunities for their organizations. Deliver educationally focused marketing events: Prepare and present informational events for contacts at prospective and current clients. Develop our consultancy: Contribute to recruiting, training, and managing our people.  Additional Benefits We individually select each of our consultants very carefully through our comprehensive interview and assessment process. We place a great deal of value on consultants’ growth and wellbeing. In addition to a challenging and rewarding career path, Thorogood offers the following benefits: Very competitive salary and compensation program Company-sponsored health coverage Incentive programs Opportunities for national and international travel Focus on work-life balance  Location and Timing This position is based in our São Paulo office. Our consultants are currently working in a hybrid model and are expected to work in São Paulo-SP, Brazil. The expected start date for this position is January 2026 or July 2026, depending on candidate start date availability. About You Qualified candidates must  have: Fluency  in written and spoken English and Portuguese Strong interest in business, people, and technology Strong academic record in a related discipline, including engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics, business, management, or another business and quantitative-focused field Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with graduation between November 2024 and June 2026  Candidates must demonstrate effectiveness in: Working individually and as part of project teams Maintaining responsibility and accountability for quality and work delivery Client focus and relationship management Time management and priority setting Data awareness and business interest Learning new technologies  This is an entry-level position; no prior full-time employment experience is required . Please do highlight if you have studied or worked with: Cloud Data & AI technology platforms, e.g. Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform SQL, Python, R, Scala, Spark, or any other programming or statistical programming languages and frameworks Applied mathematics, statistics, probability, machine learning, or artificial intelligence Structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data storage, transformation, or analysis  How to Apply All stages of the recruitment process will be held in English. Your application must  include both your résumé and a short video describing your interest and ability to succeed in this position, provided entirely in English . Sobre a oportunidade   A Dataside está apoiando um cliente estratégico em uma jornada de evolução do seu modelo de dados rumo a uma abordagem moderna e descentralizada. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente, com forte atuação consultiva e visão de arquitetura empresarial, para liderar a fase inicial de concepção, estruturação e orientação estratégica  do modelo de Data Mesh .  Este papel não envolve implementação técnica nesse primeiro momento. Trata-se de ser a referência interna , o porta-voz do tema  e o guia responsável por apoiar a organização nas decisões corretas antes de avançar para a execução.  Responsabilidades    Atuar como evangelista e consultor(a)  de Data Mesh, disseminando conceitos, boas práticas e direcionamentos estratégicos.  Conduzir a fase de entendimento, concepção e planejamento  do modelo Data Mesh, alinhando expectativas, premissas e objetivos de negócio.  Orientar a organização sobre o que deve ou não ser feito  em uma adoção madura de Data Mesh, trazendo visão crítica e prática baseada em experiências anteriores.  Apoiar na definição das capacidades organizacionais , papéis , responsabilidades , processos  e governança  necessárias para estruturar um modelo descentralizado.  Mapear riscos, dependências e requisitos antes do início da implementação técnica.  Oferecer recomendações de arquitetura, padrões e frameworks para suportar a jornada de Data Mesh.  Facilitar discussões entre áreas, aproximando times de negócio, tecnologia e dados.  Elaborar materiais executivos, guias e frameworks que suportem a tomada de decisão.  Acompanhar a evolução do roadmap, garantindo alinhamento estratégico entre stakeholders.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência prática e comprovada com Data Mesh , incluindo concepção, implementação ou governança de domínios de dados.  Forte conhecimento em governança de dados , incluindo políticas, processos, operação e modelos organizacionais.  Experiência como Arquiteto(a) de Dados , Enterprise Architect, Data Strategist ou função equivalente.  Perfil altamente consultivo, com habilidade de traduzir conceitos complexos em direcionamentos claros para executivos e times técnicos.  Experiência com arquiteturas de dados em cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP).  Conhecimento sólido em Databricks , incluindo boas práticas, governança, modelo de uso e integração com ecossistemas de dados.  Vivência em ambientes corporativos que exigem integração entre áreas, descentralização e criação de capacidades organizacionais.  Conhecimento sólido de boas práticas de engenharia, qualidade, interoperabilidade e gestão de dados.    Diferenciais    Experiência com modelos operacionais de dados em larga escala (ex.: Data Mesh, Data Fabric, domínios de dados).  Histórico de atuação em projetos de transformação organizacional ou reestruturação de plataformas de dados.  Vivência em indústrias reguladas.  Capacidade de conduzir workshops, treinamentos e jornadas de evangelização técnica.    Soft Skills valorizadas    Comunicação clara e orientada à influência.  Visão sistêmica e estratégica.  Condução consultiva, com foco em resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.  Liderança sem autoridade formal, com forte habilidade de articulação entre áreas.  Pensamento crítico e autonomia.    Nossos incentivos  ⭐   Auxílio médico : ajuda de custo mensal para apoiar na contratação do seu plano de saúde.  Wellhub , pra manter corpo e mente ativos, do jeito que você gosta.  Terapia online  100% custeada pela empresa, porque saúde mental importa.  Atendimento em Nutrição online , com até 2 consultas mensais para cuidar da sua saúde alimentar.  Seguro de vida  com apólice no valor de R$125 mil, garantindo mais segurança para você e sua família.  Day off no aniversário , porque o seu dia merece ser especial.  Descanso remunerado , para que você possa recarregar as energias.  Gamificação interna , transformando conquistas em prêmios e reconhecimento.  Parcerias educacionais com faculdades  como FIAP, Anhanguera e Instituto Infnet, pra apoiar seu crescimento e aprendizado.  Bônus por certificação técnica , reconhecendo e recompensando seu esforço em aprender. A Jaguar Mining está comprometida em promover a diversidade e a inclusão em sua equipe, e, por isso, encoraja indivíduos de diferentes origens e identidades a se candidatarem a esta oportunidade.  Estamos empenhados em criar um ambiente de trabalho mais equitativo, onde valorizamos as características únicas de cada pessoa. Queremos evoluir junto com a sociedade, e esse é um passo fundamental para alcançarmos essa meta. Junte-se a nós nesta jornada em direção a um futuro mais inclusivo e diversificado.  Venha fazer parte do nosso time como Engenheiro(a) de Segurança do Trabalho.  Principais Atividades   Gerenciar riscos ocupacionais e apoiar a atualização do PGR (Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos), em conformidade com a NR-22.  Conduzir avaliações de risco, inspeções de campo e análises de acidentes e quase-acidentes, garantindo a execução das ações corretivas e preventivas.  Analisar indicadores de desempenho (taxas de frequência e gravidade, desvios, quase-acidentes) e propor planos de ação baseados em dados.  Contribuir com projetos de engenharia segura, apoiando novas frentes de lavra ou expansões.  Elaborar e revisar procedimentos operacionais e de segurança aplicáveis às atividades subterrâneas (lavra, ventilação, transporte, explosivos, manutenção, etc.) e outros processos produtivos.  Planejar, ministrar e controlar treinamentos legais e técnicos de segurança (NR-22, NR-33, NR-35, uso de EPI, resgate e emergências em mina).  Supervisionar e interpretar monitoramentos ambientais e ocupacionais (gases, poeiras, ruído, calor, ventilação).  Acompanhar auditorias internas, externas e fiscalizações (MTE, ANM, Corpo de Bombeiros), garantindo o atendimento às não conformidades.  Participar da elaboração e execução do Plano de Ação de Emergência (PAE) e dos simulados de evacuação e resgate na unidade.  Apoiar o desenvolvimento de cultura de segurança comportamental, promovendo a participação e o engajamento das equipes operacionais.  Promover campanhas de sensibilização e programas de cultura de segurança, incentivando comportamento seguro e reporte de desvios.  Apoiar o desenvolvimento de lideranças de segurança (supervisores e encarregados), fortalecendo o papel deles como multiplicadores.  Atuar em conjunto com Geotecnia, Ventilação, Operação de Mina, Manutenção, Saúde Ocupacional e Meio Ambiente, garantindo integração das práticas de segurança.  Apoiar investigações de eventos de estabilidade geotécnica e quedas de rocha sob a ótica da segurança do trabalho.  Manter indicadores de desempenho de segurança atualizados e propor planos de melhoria contínua. Registro no CREA ativo. Experiência com novas tecnologias de monitoramento de segurança  Certificações em Primeiros Socorros, Resgate em Mina  Participação em projetos de cultura de segurança ou Safety leadership. As a Sales Executive at Container xChange, you’ll engage in high-volume B2B container sales into the US market  and help scale our growth rapidly. You’ll manage the full sales cycle , build and own a portfolio of buyers , and play a key role in transforming container trading globally .  This is a highly transactional, full-cycle role  where you will grow your buyer portfolio while closing +300 deals per month . You will work with a qualified lead pool of roughly 15,000 potential buyers and convert both outbound and inbound demand into closed business.  You will run the entire sales cycle : prospecting, outbound calling, qualification, pricing, negotiation, and closing. Once buyers are activated, 70 to 80 percent of your revenue will come from repeat purchases, allowing you to scale your portfolio fast.  Selling into the US market requires strong English skills, speed, commercial judgment , and the ability to operate in a fragmented buyer landscape. Experience working with American customers is highly preferred.     Location  Where you'll be based and how we collaborate globally.   Our headquarters is located in the heart of Hamburg, Germany, with team members distributed across the globe. This is a hybrid position based in São Paulo, Brazil , where you’ll regularly collaborate in person with local colleagues to share ideas and drive customer success while having the flexibility to work from home as well. Since you’ll be targeting the U.S. market, U.S. time zone is required.  🚀 Your Impact  What you'll own, drive, and contribute to our success.   In this role, you will directly shape the future of container trading by helping us build the distribution channel for the entire industry  — giving buyers access to a unified global inventory, transparent price competition, and standardized fulfillment and guarantees. Your work will have a measurable impact on growth, customer experience, and market expansion.    Build and manage a portfolio of US buyers and close high volumes of container deals   Conduct high outbound activity  to find and convert demand, supported by a strong inbound engine  Work with fast sales cycles  and maintain momentum across hundreds of deals  Match customer needs with available inventory and negotiates pricing and margins effectively   Use AI powered sales tool stack  to maximize buyer experience and sales to track leads, monitor sales performance, and gain insights to continuously improve conversion rates      What Makes You a Great Fit?  The experience, skills, and mindset that will help you thrive.   We believe attitude beats years of experience. We’re looking for someone with a winning, competitive mindset  — someone who treats every deal as an opportunity, thrives under high volume , and brings the drive needed to succeed in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment .  You’re a great fit if you:   Have hands-on B2B sales experience  with strong outbound and cold-calling skills - ideally within a fast-paced transactional sales environment  Thrive in transactional sales  and can manage 300+ fast-cycle deals per month  Own the full sales cycle end to end  — from outbound prospecting and qualification to negotiation and closing  Are self-sufficient in pipeline generation , proactive in outbound activity, and confident converting warm leads from our strong inbound engine  Are comfortable selling to the US B2B market  and navigating a fragmented landscape of many smaller customers with frequent repeat purchases  Communicate clearly, negotiate confidently , and manage a large pipeline with discipline  Think entrepreneurial , act proactively, and stay organized and motivated while handling many fast-moving opportunities  Bring drive, resilience, and a success attitude  where every deal counts      What to Expect  Insights into perks, culture, and earning potential.  Uncapped Earning potential:  Our commission model rewards true hunters. With high transaction volumes and fast cycles, your results directly drive your income.  Ownership & impact at xChange:  You will have a direct stake in xChange as a shareholder with a competitive virtual equity package! You will also have full ownership and trust to drive impactful topics, supported by smart and driven individuals. Plus, get personal coaching and counseling ...  Entrepreneurial freedom:  You run your own pipeline, own your deals, and can make immediate impact from day one.  xChange culture & collaboration:  Our diverse and talented team operates with flat hierarchies and a growth-focused mindset which fosters an open-minded, collaborative, and high-performance driven culture where A-players thrive.  AI Focus:  We believe AI is a game-changer for sales success. At xChange, you’ll get hands-on experience with AI tools designed to streamline sales operations, enhance your skills, and boost your conversion rates. This is a unique opportunity to grow alongside AI technologies that will empower you to work smarter and close more deals.  Other perks at xChange:  36 off days for remote employees outside of Germany, mental healthcare & coaching program, language courses and many more. Feel free to ask the Talent team for details 😊  If this sounds like your future job, all we need is your CV which you can submit through the application link!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Backend Engineer (Global Bank Tribe)
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Backend Engineer (Global Bank Tribe) em florianópolis. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

SumUp enables businesses to get paid easily, process orders quickly, sell online instantly and manage their money more efficiently. We create the tools businesses need to make their business and their customer experience thrive!  As a key member of the Global Bank tribe, you’ll play a key part in helping us build SumUp's own digital bank. You’ll be part of a global, autonomous, cross‑functional team that takes an aspect of our product and perfects it from concept to execution. Becoming a part of the Global Bank Tribe means working alongside ~200 people of 32 nationalities across Cologne, Berlin, São Paulo, Santiago, Sofia, and Vilnius who love to take ownership, work with purpose, and help businesses thrive.  As a Senior Backend Engineer for our tribe, you will be responsible for evolving and maintaining the Brazilian side of the Transfers and Cards ecosystem inside SumUp Global Bank tribe, working within a highly‑available platform that operates with money transfers in various payment systems.  Please note that this position is hybrid in Florianópolis, SC - Brazil.  What You’ll Do   Evolve and maintain the Brazilian segment of the Transfers ecosystem within SumUp Global Bank tribe.  Supporting the transition from a localized setup with regional banks to a unified Global Bank.  Design, implement, and iteratively develop highly available backend services, while continuously evaluating and implementing new methods to ensure the high reliability of transfer systems.  Maintain and improve core services utilizing a modern, cloud‑native technology stack (AWS), with microservices (Docker, K8s) written in Go/Kotlin and Elixir.  Design, implement, and iteratively develop highly available backend services.  Improve test coverage for existing services and own the end‑to‑end delivery of changes, including testing, observability, and monitoring.  Continuously improve our engineering culture by refining best practices, clarifying problems and opportunities, prototyping solutions, providing comprehensive documentation, and selecting new tools and technologies.    You’ll be great for this role if   You are proficient in one or more modern backend languages, we use: Golang, Elixir, Kotlin, Java, Ruby, or one functional programming language.  You are experienced in developing and maintaining distributed microservices and RESTful APIs.  You have prior experience with modern cloud technologies (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).  You are knowledgeable in event streaming platforms and messaging brokers such as Kafka and RabbitMQ.  You have demonstrated an ability to learn new languages and technologies.  You feel comfortable working with SQL and NoSQL databases.  You have experience with CI/CD products such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD.  You take pride in your work, have a keen sense of ownership, and are dedicated to writing clear, maintainable, and testable code.  You’re a product‑focused engineer who is passionate and curious about solving user challenges.  Have great English communication skills - you'll be part of a truly global team!    Why you should join SumUp    Career Growth: Be part of a global team working on large‑scale fintech products used by millions of businesses.    Learning & Development: Access an annual budget of R$ 10,000 for education, certifications, and conferences.    Time Off: Enjoy 30 additional days off through our Break4Me program after 3 years at SumUp.    Grow with Us: Participate in our virtual stock program and benefit from SumUp’s success with company shares.    Global Experience: Collaborate with a diverse team of 3,000+ people from over 90 countries, and join our global off‑sites and hackathons.  🤝 Collaborative Culture: Join a team that values diversity, innovation, and teamwork, where your ideas and contributions truly matter.    Great Benefits: Health plans, meal vouchers (VR), Zenklub, Wellhub, life insurance, childcare allowance, and more.  Learn More About SumUp  🇧🇷 Office tour at São Paulo    Ask me anything: Engineering at SumUp  🚀 SumUp’s Innovation Hackathon  🤝 Get to know our hiring process  Job Application Tip  We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Software Engineer, Backend (All teams) – Brazil – Vaga para mulheres  Engineering the future of logistics – from Brazil to the world  This role is part of our commitment to increase the representation of women in technology at DoorDash Brazil. We strongly encourage candidates who identify as women to apply.  We are building an engineering team where women have equitable access to opportunity, leadership, and long-term career growth within our São Paulo hub.  At DoorDash, we believe diverse teams build better products. This opportunity is designed to create greater equity in access to engineering roles and long-term career growth within our São Paulo engineering hub.  DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on-demand logistics platform. As part of our global expansion, we are investing heavily in Brazil and growing our engineering presence in São Paulo. This is a unique opportunity to join one of Silicon Valley’s fastest-growing companies—while staying close to home.  We’re looking for Backend Engineers who are excited to solve real-world problems at scale. You’ll work on product teams or platform teams that power our three-sided marketplace of Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants . From improving restaurant discovery to optimizing delivery logistics, you’ll help shape the experience of millions of users.  You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers—many based in the U.S.—so fluency in English and strong collaboration skills are essential.  What you’ll do   Design, build, and maintain large-scale backend systems used by millions of users  Contribute to our technical roadmap and define the architecture for key product areas  Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability, and security  Help transition parts of our monolithic codebase to a microservices architecture  Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Brazil and the U.S.  Work on high-impact features that directly improve the user experience for Dashers, Merchants, or Consumers    We’re excited about you because…   You have 1+ years of experience with backend technologies and distributed systems  You’re comfortable with modern web architecture (HTTP, REST APIs, grpc, microservices)  You’ve worked with relational and non-relational databases  You enjoy solving complex problems with elegant code and clear thinking  You’re fluent in English and confident participating in meetings and code reviews in English  You care about quality and write tests to ensure your code works as expected  You take ownership and enjoy working with autonomy in a fast-paced environment    Nice to haves   Experience working at a tech company with scale  Familiarity with Java, Kotlin, or similar JVM languages  Exposure to big data technologies or event-driven architecture  Interest in mentorship or growing into a technical leadership role    Why join DoorDash Brazil?   Work on a global product, with real impact on millions of people  Be part of a fast-growing engineering hub in São Paulo  Hybrid remote model with great office space in Av. Paulista  English immersion and opportunities to grow your international career  Contribute to a modern, scalable platform used across multiple countries  Build the future of local commerce with a team that values ownership, humility, and getting 1% better every day  Be part of a growing engineering organization committed to building inclusive teams and equitable opportunities    About DoorDash  At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We\'re committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.  Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion  We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.  This position is open to candidates with disabilities. DoorDash welcomes applicants registered with the national autism registry (SisTEA) and others who seek an inclusive workplace. If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

**Job Description:****Nextpower – Structural Engineer I****Location**: Sorocaba, Brazil**Reporting**: Director of Civil - Geotechnical Engineering**Work Type:** Hybrid - 4 days in office, 1 day remote**Language Proficiency**: Fluent in English (C1/C2 level required)Nextpower is the leading provider of intelligent, integrated solar tracker and software solutions used in utility-scale and ground-mounted distributed generation solar projects around the world. Nextpower has been the number one global market-share solar tracker company with an average market share of 30% for seven years and counting, according to global research firms Wood Mackenzie and IHS Markit.Nextpower pioneered smart solar tracking technology and continues to lead the industry with our design, engineering and software innovation. Our robust portfolio of intellectual property protects both our hardware and software products, and includes 132 mechanical patents, 52 electronics & controls patents, and 171 software-driven yield improvement patents.At Nextpower, we are on a mission to be the most trusted and valued renewable energy company by delivering intelligent, reliable, and productive solar power. We are a diverse group of technology innovators and clean energy activators. We are collaborative team players, accountable and deliver results. We are committed to sustainability, decarbonization and a better tomorrow.**About the Role**Nextpower is seeking a **Structural Engineer I** to join our **Project Engineering Team** , supporting key accounts across the **U.S and North America markets.** This position will be responsible for managing day-to-day structural engineering tasks for foundations of utility-scale PV projects from the development phase through construction.Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, wind load calculations, steel design, component sizing, foundation sizing, structural tool development and the preparation of structural documentation to support project quoting and engineering packages. The role will involve close coordination with cross-functional teams in the U.S., India, and other global offices including Sales, Project Management, and R&D.**Key Responsibilities*** Produce civil and structural design documentation, including drawings and calculations.* Support the project development phase by reviewing site information, performing calculations, and contributing to cost estimations.* Perform structural analyses for wind, seismic, and foundation loads, and prepare corresponding calculations and reports; sign/seal documents if required.* Provide construction phase support by responding to RFIs and reviewing submittals.* Develop a comprehensive understanding of Nextpower products to support engineering decisions.* Collaborate with structural/Geotechnical/civil engineers across regions to maintain and update standards, specifications, templates, and design tools.* Manage schedules and review deliverables from structural and Foundation engineering consultants.* Support the ongoing development and expansion of Nextpower’s Design Services team.* Occasional sites visit to supervise Geotech investigations, foundation installation and pile load testing.* **Required Skills/ Expertise:**  + BS in Structural Engineering with emphasis on Foundations. MS in Structural Engineering is a plus.  + Strong knowledge of international engineering standards, codes, and other applicable state and federal guidelines, including but not limited to IBC, ASCE, ASTM, AISC, and ACI.  + Proficiency in finite element analysis software (RISA, STAAD, or equivalent)  + Proficiency in advanced modal and dynamic analysis  + Minimum of 2 years of structural engineering experience, preferably in the solar EPC industry.  + Demonstrated experience in structural design, including dead, live, snow, wind, and seismic loads, as well as steel structure design and construction documentation.  + Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel), AutoCAD,  + Proficiency in foundation tools like LPILE/AllPile, Risa foundation, Staad foundations, Plaxis and other structural analysis tools.  + Proficiency in programming languages is a plus.  + Self-motivated team player with strong communication and collaboration skills.  + Passion for renewable energy and solar power is a plus.  + Fluent English is required to communicate effectively with clients, manage international projects, and produce high-quality technical documentation.At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.# **We are Nextpower**#J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Especialista de produtos
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Especialista de produtos em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Aqui, temos um grande time que faz tudo acontecer! É com o esforço e a dedicação de cada uma de nossas Pessoas que somos hoje referência no que fazemos, atuando unidos no nosso propósito, que é “Conectar para uma vida mais divertida e produtiva”. Somamos todas as tecnologias para criar a melhor e mais completa infraestrutura de conectividade do País. Somos multicampeões confirmado pelo Speedtest como Internet móvel mais rápida e estável e com rede wi-fi mais estável do Brasil, entre tantos outros reconhecimentos. Também somos a 5º marca mais valiosa do Brasil (BrandZ). Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos. E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento  (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças  (Claro pay) e muito mais! Temos presença aeroespacial  (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio  e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn , o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel. Sustentabilidade  é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro , conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.  E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!  Gestão completa dos produtos de Dados avançado: Internet dedicada BLD e Responsável pela gestão completa dos produtos de Dados avançado , desde a concepção da ideia até o lançamento, performance financeira e estratégia de mercado. Este profissional será uma peça-chave no desenvolvimento e evolução de produtos, garantindo alinhamento entre tecnologia, negócio e experiência do cliente. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida do Produto  Desenvolver, lançar, evoluir e descontinuar os produtos conforme as necessidades do mercado e da empresa. Garantir que os produtos estejam sempre atualizados, competitivos e aderentes à estratégia da Claro Empresas.  Pesquisa e Benchmark de Mercado  Monitorar tendências, concorrentes e novas tecnologias. Conduzir pesquisas de mercado, benchmark e análise de concorrência para identificar oportunidades e tendências. Identificar oportunidades de novos produtos ou melhorias em soluções existentes, com foco em PMEs. Buscar e negociar com parceiros estratégicos. Avaliar viabilidade técnica, comercial e operacional das parcerias. Desenvolver business cases para novos produtos e iniciativas, validando viabilidade técnica, comercial e financeira.  Roadmap e Planejamento Estratégico  Definir visão, estratégia e roadmap dos produtos. Estabelecer metas de crescimento, penetração e receita para cada solução. Trabalhar em conjunto com Marketing, Vendas, Canais, Tecnologia, Jurídico e Atendimento para garantir o sucesso do produto. Garantir o alinhamento com as diretrizes da Claro e a jornada do cliente. Definir requisitos de produto em parceria com áreas de tecnologia, engenharia, marketing e atendimento.  Precificação e Modelo de Receita  Definir preços competitivos e políticas de desconto com base em benchmarks e estrutura de custo.  Go-to-Market e Lançamentos  Planejar e coordenar o lançamento de produtos: materiais, treinamentos, campanhas e argumentação comercial. Garantir a execução da estratégia de GTM (Go-to-Market), em conjunto com times comercial, canais e comunicação. Suportar os times de vendas com conteúdo e diferenciais do produto. Monitorar métricas de uso, receita, churn e NPS. Monitorar KPIs de performance, churn, receita, margem e adotar ações corretivas quando necessário. Propor ações corretivas ou de aceleração com base em dados e feedback dos clientes. Gerenciar o P&L dos produtos, atuando proativamente na rentabilidade e expansão do portfólio. Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes (PMEs). Realizar entrevistas, pesquisas e testes de usabilidade. Fomentar a inovação contínua com foco na experiência do cliente, eficiência operacional e diferenciação de mercado. Influenciar stakeholders internos e externos, assegurando alinhamento e execução eficaz da estratégia do produto.  O que esperamos de você?  Perfil Comercial: garra para fazer acontecer, foco no resultado, perfil consultivo e escuta ativa do cliente; Empreendedorismo: visão de dono, sentir-se e colocar-se como conhecedor da sua carteira de clientes; Digital: antenado à tecnologia e inovação, facilidade para manusear a aprender a lidar com softwares e sistemas; Capacidade de Organização, Planejamento e Disciplina: senso de urgência, distribui bem suas tarefas e concluí-las ao longo do dia; Curiosidade: é inquieto! Quer aprender sempre mais, propõe novas soluções e questiona o status quo; Resiliência: capacidade de lidar com as adversidades e tornar as dificuldades aprendizados para futuras ações; Atitude, Ambição e Inconformismo: não se limita ao básico, quer algo mais e oferece além. Tem iniciativa para se antecipar a demanda e a necessidade do cliente; Relacionamento com Cliente/Empatia Digital: vê o cliente como sua prioridade, traduz a necessidade do cliente pensando na melhor solução para atendê-lo mantendo a visão de dono. Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:  Graduação em Marketing, Administração, Engenharia, Economia, TI ou áreas correlatas Experiência sólida em gestão de produtos no setor de telecomunicações ou tecnologia. Vivência com P&L, GTM, desenho de produto e atuação em squads multidisciplinares. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Produtos, Marketing ou áreas afins; Inglês e espanhol intermediário/avançado; Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas como Jira, Confluence; Conhecimento em SQL para análise de dados e extração de insights.  E por que a escolher a Claro?  Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores! Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só: . Assistência Médica . Assistência Odontológica . Auxílio para patologias graves · Vale-Refeição e Alimentação · Auxílio ao Dependente com Deficiência · Previdência Privada . Seguro saúde - Pets . Wellhub · Convênios e Parcerias Na nossa empresa, valorizamos um ambiente inclusivo, diverso, ético, colaborativo e harmônico. Não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, posição social ou deficiências. Todos e todas são bem-vindos(as)! Our cloud‑based platform empowers firms to build and launch financial products rapidly, scaling as they grow to a broader audience while maintaining high security and availability standards. Pismo has 500+ employees located in more than 10 countries worldwide. This squad delivers all accounting entries of the Pismo platform to clients through the generation of platform events. Lead multiple initiatives by overseeing planning, estimation, prioritization, resource allocation, and execution, all within Agile methodologies.  Implement and enforce best practices for software development (coding standards, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD).  Collaborate closely with the tribe QAs and Data team to ensure the quality of accounting deliveries and reports.  Collaborate with product managers, engineering managers, and stakeholders to align technical solutions with business requirements.  Communicate plans, progress, risks, and technical decisions clearly and consistently to stakeholders.  Support the team in ensuring robust scalability practices, including metrics, distributed tracing, and log aggregation, to meet SLOs and SLAs.    This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties to be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may require presence at a Visa office with scheduled notice.  Qualifications   Must be based in Brazil.    Language Skills   Proficiency in English at B2 level or above (Upper‑Intermediate).    Technical Skills   3+ years of experience with Golang.  Experience with AWS services: SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, S3, and EventBridge.  Solid understanding of distributed systems and microservices.  Experience with REST APIs. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Docker/Containers.  Knowledge of messaging systems and event‑driven architectures.  Understanding of observability practices (monitoring, tracing, alerting).  Background in Agile methodologies and production support.  Hands‑on experience with Terraform or other IaC tools.
