Backed by $20 million in funding from visionary investors like Left Lane Capital, Soma Capital, Aglaé Ventures, and 1984 Ventures—and recognized as one of Bain Capital Ventures’ Top 50 Vertical SaaS Startups of 2024—we’re addressing the increasing complexity of modern vehicles and the ripple effect it’s having on repair shops. Our AI-powered platform is transforming how shops handle advanced vehicle safety systems, delivering actionable insights that streamline workflows, boost revenue, and enhance vehicle safety. With over 2,100 repair locations onboarded and seven figures in annual recurring revenue achieved in record time, we’re scaling rapidly—but this is only the beginning. At Revv, we’re not just changing the way repairs are done—we’re redefining the legacy of an industry that impacts millions of lives every day. Our bold vision is to become the global leader in auto repair technology, empowering shops of every size to master increasingly complex vehicles while ensuring safer roads for all. With our co-founders being named as Forbes 30 Under 30, support from industry leaders like Abhi Ramesh of Misfits Market, and an award-winning product celebrated for its innovation, Revv is setting a new standard for safety, efficiency, and growth. If you’re ready to join a team that’s shaping the future, rewriting the rules, and leaving a lasting legacy, we want to hear from you. Together, let’s revolutionize auto repair and build a smarter, safer world. Learn more about our journey here:  AlleyWatch About the Role  We’re hiring our first international Full Stack Engineer to take ownership of end-to-end product features, from database design to frontend components. This is a senior, backend-leaning role (roughly 70/30 backend/frontend) for engineers who thrive in fast-moving environments, write clean, maintainable code, and are ready to shape the technical foundation of our first engineering office in São Paulo. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to build scalable backend services, contribute to frontend features where needed, and establish technical best practices. Your work will directly impact thousands of repair shops and help scale a platform that’s redefining an entire industry. Responsibilities  Development  Design, build, and maintain backend services in Node.js/Express with TypeScript. Work with PostgreSQL for schema design, queries, and performance optimization. Implement APIs and integrations with external systems and internal services. Ensure backend systems are reliable, secure, and scalable. Build and maintain frontend components in TypeScript, using React/Next.js. Collaborate with design teams to translate wireframes and user flows into responsive, high-quality UI. Ensure robust, maintainable, and low-defect code. Write and maintain unit tests.  Collaboration & Delivery  Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback. Engage in architectural discussions and system design decisions. Work cross-functionally with PMs, designers, and non-technical stakeholders to align on priorities and timelines. Deliver high-quality features quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.  Leadership & Growth  Help define engineering standards (coding style, testing, CI/CD) for our international team. Serve as the anchor engineer for the São Paulo office, with potential to grow into mentorship or leadership as the team expands. Model best practices in communication, collaboration, and technical execution.  Qualifications  Must-Have  7+ years as a Full Stack Engineer, with strong backend focus (70/30 backend/frontend split preferred). Experience in SaaS development, ideally in B2B or infrastructure-heavy environments. Proficiency in Node.js/Express with TypeScript. Advanced PostgreSQL skills (schema design, queries, indexing, optimization). Track record of end-to-end project ownership (database to production). Experience writing and maintaining unit and integration tests. Active contributor to code reviews and improving team code quality. Proven ability to deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines. Strong collaboration skills with PMs, designers, and non-technical stakeholders. Written and spoken fluency in English.  Nice-to-Have  Frontend expertise in React/Next.js. Experience building integration test frameworks. Prior mentorship or leadership experience. Experience working in high-growth startups, navigating fast-moving environments, evolving priorities, and scaling engineering teams or products.  Why Join Revv?  Own end-to-end features that immediately impact customers. Shape the technical foundation of our first international office. Clear path into mentorship and engineering leadership. Work at the intersection of AI, automotive safety, and SaaS innovation. Collaborate with U.S. and international teams, gaining exposure to world-class SaaS practices.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.  You will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail. Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development. Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team. Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.  Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.    You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You   3–6+ years of senior‑level design experience, with at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred. Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.  Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.  Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.  Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.  Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.  Bonus: Experience in e‑commerce or hospitality website design, familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.    Working at Darkroom  Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.  We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.   Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.  Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.  Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.    Equal Opportunity Statement  Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. You’ll be part of a global, autonomous, cross-functional team that takes an aspect of our product and perfects it from concept to execution. You’re a product-focused engineer who is passionate and curious about solving user challenges. Have great English communication skills - you'll be part of a truly global team! Why you should join SumUpWe’re a truly global team of 3200+ people from 80+ countries, spread across 4 continents The opportunity to work on large-scale fintech products used by millions of small businesses around the world A dedicated annual Learning & Development budget (R$10.000/ year) for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education Enrollment in our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success A corporate pension scheme The opportunity to work on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses around the world Access to the SumUp Sabbatical, our Employee assistance program for mental health as well as Fitness and language learning benefits. Este(a) profissional será responsável por desenhar, implementar e manter frameworks de testes automatizados, integrados a ambientes de entrega contínua e infraestrutura em nuvem.  Principais atividades   Projetar e implementar testes automatizados (unitários, funcionais, integração, regressão, performance e segurança) alinhados aos pipelines CI/CD.  Integrar frameworks de automação (ex.: Cypress, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, JUnit, TestNG, Pytest) aos pipelines em ferramentas como GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou CircleCI .  Garantir cobertura de testes em aplicações web, mobile (Flutter)  e serviços backend (APIs REST/GraphQL) .  Colaborar com times de Dev, DevOps e Produto  para definir critérios de aceitação e estratégias de teste automatizado.  Construir e evoluir pipelines de qualidade  (build, test, deploy, rollback, monitoramento).  Implementar testes de carga e stress  com ferramentas como JMeter, k6, Locust .  Atuar na observabilidade da qualidade , integrando relatórios de testes com dashboards (ex.: Grafana, Allure, SonarQube).  Apoiar a cultura de Shift Left Testing , incorporando qualidade desde o início do ciclo de desenvolvimento.    Requisitos   Experiência sólida com automação de testes  (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright ou similares).  Conhecimento avançado em CI/CD pipelines  (GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI).  Experiência em testes de APIs  (Postman, RestAssured, Newman).  Experiência em testes para mobile  (Appium, Detox, Flutter Driver).  Experiência em containers e nuvem  (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).  Conhecimento em testes de performance  (JMeter, k6, Locust).  Familiaridade com práticas de segurança e compliance  em testes (OWASP, LGPD, PCI-DSS).  Integração de automação com monitoramento e métricas  (Allure, SonarQube, Grafana).  Mentalidade data-driven , guiada por métricas de qualidade.  Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa  com squads multidisciplinares.  Foco em entregas rápidas e de impacto  sem comprometer a qualidade.  Atenção a detalhes e pensamento crítico  para identificar riscos.  Proatividade na resolução de problemas  e melhoria contínua dos processos.  Boa comunicação para atuar junto a C-levels e stakeholders .    Diferenciais   Experiência em fintechs ou meios de pagamento .  Conhecimento em teste de contratos (PACT) .  Experiência com Infra as Code (Terraform)  e FinOps  para otimizar custos em ambientes de teste.  Certificações ISTQB, AWS ou similares.    Informações da Vaga   Horário:  Segunda a sexta-feira (modelo híbrido 3x2)  Regime de contratação:  PJ  Plano de saúde e odontológico Amil   Vale Alimentação + Vale Refeição    Interessados podem enviar o currículo diretamente para:    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Zoetis values and supports inclusion, and is committed to equal opportunities.  Position Summary  Responsible for upholding the highest standards of ethical care and welfare for research subjects at the Zoetis Research Center in Paulínia, ensuring full compliance with all company policies as well as relevant local and international regulations and legislation concerning research practices. Additional responsibilities include supporting in vivo studies, training colleagues, and providing backup in related procedures. The role also involves establishing and monitoring key welfare and care metrics across the research operations.  Responsibilities   In collaboration with area management, develop and maintain a high-quality care program to promote health, wellbeing, and regulatory compliance for research activities at the Paulínia site. Focus areas include: disease prevention, biosafety, sanitation, pest control, management practices, safe handling protocols, responsible medication use and storage, and humane endpoints.  Perform daily rounds throughout the site to conduct veterinary inspections, ensuring optimal welfare conditions and that teams adhere to established procedures.  Maintain comprehensive records for research subjects to ensure traceability and documentation of medical history.  Guarantee ready access to controlled and non-controlled medications for research needs.  In collaboration with CEUA, expand and apply knowledge regarding local regulations and Zoetis internal standards to support accreditation and sustain best practice requirements.  Ensure complete alignment with Zoetis policies and the laws and guidelines of relevant authorities such as CONCEA, MAPA, CRMV, and others.  Actively participate in committee meetings and protocol reviews, sharing relevant updates and decisions with site teams in partnership with area leadership.  Report and communicate any events or concerns related to research subjects according to internal protocols and external regulations, updating the global team and implementing preventive measures as needed.  Provide technical expertise in veterinary science to support Zoetis and VMRD objectives, meeting client needs and contributing to collaborative scientific and service outcomes.  Apply scientific principles and practices to the development of tools and technologies that advance research models for drug discovery and development.  Collaborate with project teams to support research initiatives, including protocol and model development.  Foster communication between VMRD and GMS, serving as a role model for the broader Zoetis organization and presenting results internally and externally.  Train, educate, and guide colleagues in best practices regarding clinical procedures, research handling, care, and experiment-related workflows.  Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, emphasizing the principles of the 3Rs wherever possible.  Serve as the representative of the Paulínia site on the Zoetis Global Animal Welfare Committee.  As part of contingency planning, support in vivo research activities when needed.  Proactively prevent unsafe practices by following established safety guidelines and ensuring proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).  Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.    Requirements   Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Medicine, with an active CRMV license for at least 5 years.  Previous technical experience with the facility's working species – poultry and rodents – is desirable.  Solid experience in animal facilities or in the animal health products industry is preferred.  Advanced English proficiency.  A master's or PhD degree is desirable to provide additional technical support to the research team.  Planning and organizational skills.  Ability to work effectively in a team.  Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) principles.  Strong interpersonal skills to ensure positive relationships with colleagues from other departments.  In-depth knowledge of animal welfare and relevant regulations.  Activities are primarily concentrated at the animal facility located in Paulínia.  Work is preferably performed while standing, and requires moving between multiple buildings within the facility. Access to each building that houses different species must be performed according to established standard procedures, including changing clothes, showering, and other relevant protocols.  The employee must be willing to work weekends and outside of regular hours as required, according to on‑call schedules and veterinary occurrences.  The collaborator must also be available for activities outside the Paulínia site, such as meetings at Zoetis units in Campinas and/or São Paulo, visits to service providers and suppliers, as well as participation in events related to the field.    About Zoetis  At Zoetis, our purpose is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. As a Fortune 500 company and the world leader in animal health, we discover, develop, manufacture and commercialize vaccines, medicines, diagnostics and other technologies for companion animals and livestock. We know our people drive our success. Our award‑winning culture, built around our Core Beliefs, focuses on our colleagues' careers, connection and support. We offer competitive healthcare and retirement savings benefits, along with an array of benefits, policies and programs to support employee well‑being in every sense, from health and financial wellness to family and lifestyle resources.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices. You’ll also drive the team and our clients to use cutting-edge techniques and processes for software delivery, and use your technical prowess to shape the solutions we create. Success looks like an energized, happy team building high-quality software for eager, engaged client stakeholders.  We understand our responsibility to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive place within the tech industry, while pushing to make our industry more representative. Because of this responsibility, we need candidates who value diversity and inclusion through their work, team collaboration, or mentorship.  Qualifications   Have professional engineering experience — at least 5 years building digital products, and at least 2 years leading a team;  Have professional engineering experience with Mobile app development technologies (Android, IOS or React Native) and/or Web development technologies (React, Next, Angular, Vue; Node, .NET, Java);  Have managed a team of software engineers building digital products, and been responsible for growing the people on the team through goal-setting, coaching and feedback;  Have familiarity with CI/CD, Agile techniques for managing work, pairing, mobbing, and shift-left testing;  Have owned the delivery of a complete digital product, with code that is durable, secure, scalable and thoroughly tested;  Can simplify and communicate about complex problems around technology, business processes, user experience and development tasks;  Fluent English and Portuguese skills – including written, verbal, and presentation;  This role is open to our São Paulo  or Porto Alegre  office.    Bonus Points   Professional experience as a Project or Product Manager and Scrum Master from a major technology consultancy or agency  You’ve guided a client to further their use of modern engineering practices or agile software delivery processes  Certifications such as CSM, CSPO, PMP, SA, SPC, etc.  Account planning and growth activities    You’ll love this job if you...   Are comfortable collaborating and communicating with teams and clients to deliver software in an agile environment  Think of the product you are building as part of an ecosystem of development, testing and deployment tools and processes  Pride yourself on your work and take responsibilities and commitments seriously  Value daily opportunities to immerse yourself deeply in your work  Celebrate differences and thrive in an environment where everyone’s unique contributions are encouraged  Value a feedback culture that fosters personal and professional growth    Why TELUS Digital?  At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter. Confira a vaga para Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end (Java) em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Ser MJVer é estar em um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar.  Acreditamos que a verdadeira evolução nasce de dentro para fora. Por isso, cultivamos um ambiente que valoriza pertencimento, troca, colaboração e autonomia. Aqui, cada pessoa tem espaço para aprender, crescer e impulsionar transformações reais. Somos plurais, criativos, ágeis e apaixonados por inovação. Somos MJV! Saiba mais: Quem Somos – MJV  Sobre a área  A área de IT Offshore Retail  atua nas plataformas que atendem equipes de Operations, Business e clientes finais da operação internacional. É um ambiente dinâmico, com forte exposição a produtos de mercado global, integrações com parceiros estratégicos e uso de tecnologias modernas. É o lugar ideal para quem gosta de desafios, decisões rápidas, alta responsabilidade e evolução contínua.  Responsabilidades   Interagir com usuários internos (Operations/Business) para levantar demandas, evoluir funcionalidades e apoiar o core business.  Atuar como ponte entre a MJV e equipes de tecnologia de parceiros externos, acompanhando integrações e novos fluxos.  Desenvolver produtos e serviços utilizados por clientes finais da plataforma.  Participar de decisões técnicas e estratégicas das demandas.    Perfil profissional ideal   Conforto em ambientes intensos, ágeis e de alta autonomia.  Organização, visão sistêmica e boa capacidade de decisão.  Forte senso de prioridade, ownership e responsabilidade.  Resiliência para lidar com cenários complexos sem perder qualidade e clareza.  Postura madura, foco em solução e capacidade de navegar por diferentes demandas.  Capacidade de atuar sem necessidade de mentoria constante ou direcionamento diário.    Pré-requisitos técnicos   Formação superior completa em TI ou áreas correlatas;  Experiência sólida com Java, Design Patterns e arquitetura de microserviços;  Experiência com containers, Kubernetes e ecossistema de microserviços;  Conhecimento em mensagerias (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.);  Domínio em tecnologias AWS (EKS, SNS, SQS, S3, DocumentDB, Secret Manager, API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB);  Experiência com bancos de dados (PostgreSQL, DocumentDB, Redis);  Boa comunicação e colaboração com diferentes áreas;  Inglês intermediário/avançado (desejável – temos posições com ou sem necessidade de Inglês).    Diferenciais   Conhecimento de mercado financeiro ou vivência em ambientes globais.    Local de trabalho  Remoto ou híbrido a partir de São Paulo (região Faria Lima), preferencialmente.  Benefícios MJV  TotalPass\Wellhub; Seguro de vida em grupo; Vale Refeição/Alimentação; Plano de saúde e odontológico - Bradesco; Ações de treinamento: palestras, fóruns, trocas e conversas de conhecimentos relativos ao nosso negócio. Estamos em constante conexão para aprender mais e juntos. vagas.title: ENGENHEIRO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO PJ - Sorocaba/SP e Região
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para ENGENHEIRO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO PJ - Sorocaba/SP e Região em boituva. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

ENGENHEIRO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO PJ - Sorocaba/SP e Região  Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa suíça, e de fazer parte de um time com mais de 90 mil colaboradores no mundo?   Junte-se a uma equipe reconhecida por sua excelência, inovação, integridade, colaboração, segurança e espírito empreendedor.   No Brasil, são 6 linhas de negócios. Business Assurance, Health & Nutrition, Connectivity & Products, Natural Resources, Industries & Environment and Education.  Responsabilidades   Responsável pelo planejamento, coordenação e implementação de sistemas, políticas e programas de gestão de saúde e segurança ocupacional, garantindo a eliminação ou redução de riscos nos ambientes de trabalho e assegurando a conformidade legal da empresa. Atuando de forma estratégica nos planos de segurança específicos para obras de pavimentação, sinalização, intervenções emergenciais em rodovias, e outras atividades relacionadas, visando a prevenção de acidentes a minimização de riscos e a prevenção de impactos ambientais. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem a análise e mitigação de riscos em atividades críticas, como operações em rodovias com tráfego ativo, e a definição de estratégias para garantir a integridade física dos colaboradores, usuários e terceiros;  Elaborar e manter atualizadas planilhas com estatísticas de acidentes de trabalho, encaminhando relatórios periódicos para órgãos fiscalizadores e áreas de controle de sustentabilidade;  Analisar demandas de órgãos reguladores e públicos externos, garantindo o envio de informações no formato exigido;  Fiscalizar irregularidades de Qualidade, Segurança, Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Compliance (QSSMA) em vistorias de campo. Assegurar a aderência aos requisitos legais, regulamentares e normas internas da empresa;  Elaborar relatórios e registros fotográficos detalhados, encaminhando-os ao gestor imediato e ao gestor responsável pela área. Garantir a execução das atividades em alinhamento com as Regras de Ouro do Grupo CCR e normas de QSSMA, promovendo comportamentos seguros e prevenindo;  Atualizar e monitorar informações em sistemas operacionais específicos, incluindo CAT, PPRA, controle de extintores, EPI/EPC, brigadas de incêndio, CIPA, e relatórios periódicos;  Supervisionar a manutenção e disponibilidade de dispositivos de combate a incêndio, como extintores, hidrantes e alarmes, em conformidade com normas regulamentares. Supervisionar empresas terceirizadas em obras, verificando o cumprimento das normas de segurança, uso de EPIs/EPCs, e dispositivos de segurança coletiva;  Elaborar, revisar e implementar anualmente o PPRA - Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, incluindo medições de riscos e propostas de soluções para mitigação;  Realizar investigações de acidentes, identificar causas-raiz e propor ações corretivas e preventivas. Acompanhar perícias judiciais relacionadas a acidentes de trabalho, em alinhamento com a área jurídica. Promover o Índice de Prática Segura (IPS) e ações de melhoria contínua com base em desvios identificados;  Apoiar iniciativas de treinamento e conscientização de segurança para equipes internas e contratadas. Contribuir para a gestão sustentável de resíduos no local de trabalho, conforme os aspectos e impactos ambientais da unidade. Monitorar e avaliar o impacto ambiental de obras em conformidade com os padrões internos e normativos.    Qualificações   Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia com Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho;  6 meses de experiência no cargo;  Experiência comprovada em obras rodoviárias ou contratos de concessão;  Pacote Office avançado.    Condições de contratação   Modelo de contratação PJ;  Residir na região de Porangaba, Boituva, Tatuí e Sorocaba;    Procuramos pessoas como você. Pessoas que vão abraçar a jornada na SGS com a mesma intensidade e paixão que nós fazemos! E aí? Topa desenvolver conexões mais fortes, seguras e mais eficientes na conosco?    #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Coordenador de Performance & KPI's em Logistica & Supply Chain em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Coordenador de Performance & KPI's em Logística & Supply Chain “Na ICL, acreditamos que a diversidade é o motor da inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas independentemente de raça, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra característica. Embora esta posição não seja afirmativa/exclusiva, reforçamos que todas as pessoas são bem-vindas a se candidatar. Valorizamos diferentes perspectivas e experiências e ficaremos felizes em receber sua candidatura!”  Sumário das Atividades:  Gerir performance operacional através de indicadores de desempenho, identificar desvios e propor ações corretivas e preventivas para garantir o atingimento de metas estabelecidas pela diretoria de Supply. Garantir a confiabilidade e integridade das informações dentro de diversas áreas de Supply utilizando ferramentas estatísticas, SAP, TMS e BI. Liderar painéis visuais e relatórios estratégicos que facilitem a tomada de decisão, apoiando a governança e transparência na gestão de performance dentro de Logística e Supply Chain. Contribuir com análise de processos e resultados para identificar oportunidades de otimização, apoiando projetos com metodologia Lean e Scrum. Liderar a execução de projetos estratégicos, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e a eficiência das ações. Suportar a gestão de orçamento operacional e assegurar que os valores gastos estejam em compliance. Apoiar a comunicação de resultados e melhorias, auxiliando na prática de inovação e eficiência dentro de Supply Chain. Promover boas práticas como ferramentas de análise e desempenho, alinhando as equipes às metas estratégicas. Apoiar na melhoria de processos e controle de pagamentos dos fornecedores contratados pela área de Supply Chain.  Requisitos:  Formação escolar: Superior completo (Administração, Engenharia, Logística ou Supply Chain), desejável pós-graduação (MBA ou Especialização em Supply Chain, Logística, Transformação Digital, Business Analytics, Gestão de Operações ou Projetos). Experiência/conhecimentos específicos: Vivência em Agronegócio e gestão de pessoas, certificações em Lean, Six Sigma, Green ou Black Belt, Gestão de Projetos, BI (Power BI ou Data Analytics). Conhecimentos desejáveis: Gestão de KPIs, Gestão de Projetos. Informática: Ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, Python, SQL e Excel avançado), SAP. Idioma(s): Inglês avançado.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Technical Consultant
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical Consultant em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Technical Consultant  Join to apply for the Technical Consultant  role at Denodo   As a passionate Technical Consultant, you will be responsible for consulting, solution/problem‑solving, and empowering our clients’ data journey using Data Virtualization.  Our customers’ projects include integrating data in a virtual manner for operational and/or analytical purposes — combining multiple data sources for Advanced Analytics; implementation of Logical Data Warehouses and Virtual Data Marts to enable modern Business Intelligence solutions; modernizing data ecosystems for Hybrid and Cloud environments; and building Agile Operational Reporting on diverse platforms are just a few flavors of your future projects.  Be part of an elite team in a rapidly growing international software product company. Your career with us will combine cutting‑edge technology, exposure to worldwide clients across all industries (Financial Services, Automotive, Insurance, Pharma, etc.), exciting growth path for technical, product, and customer‑facing roles, direct mentorship, and access to senior management as part of a global team.  Job Responsibilities & Duties  To be successful in this role you will require a combination of high technical expertise, troubleshooting skills and client management skills to conduct on‑site and off‑site consulting, product implementation and technical problem‑solving. In this position you will work directly with engineers: our own staff, our partners, and our customers.  Product and Technical Knowledge   Obtain and maintain strong knowledge of the Denodo Platform, be able to deliver a superb technical pitch, including an overview of our key and advanced features and benefits, services offerings, differentiation, and competitive positioning.  Constantly learn new things and maintain an overview of modern technologies.  Be able to address a majority of technical questions concerning customization, integration, enterprise architecture, and general features/functionality of our product.  Capable of building and/or leading the development of custom deployments based on and beyond client’s requirements.  Provide timely, prioritized, and complete customer‑based feedback to Product Management, Sales, Support and/or Development regarding client’s business cases, requirements, and issues.    Presentation and Organizational Skills   Engage clients in the product architecture, configuration, and use of the Denovo Platform.  Know when and where to elevate within the Denovo technical organization and make effective use of those resources.  Promote knowledge and best practices while managing deliverables and client expectations.    Customer Engagement   Manage client expectations, establish credibility at all levels within the client, and build problem‑solving partnerships with the client, partners, and colleagues.  Provide technical consulting and support.  Develop white papers, presentations, training materials, or documentation on related topics.    Information Security Responsibilities   Knows and understands the Security Policy and procedures that apply to their work.  Ensures that their actions do not result in any security breaches.  Informs the owner of the asset of any security incident, real or suspected, that it detects.  Is aware of and committed to the Acceptable Use Policy.    Desired Skills & Experience  Required Skills   Experience Range: 3‑15 years (new graduates must be top‑ranked and exceptionally qualified).  Fluency in English and Portuguese required; Spanish will be a plus.  University Degree relating to information systems or computer science (Bachelor’s, Master’s, Diploma).  Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to interact with technical and business counterparts.  Solid understanding of SQL and good grasp of relational and analytical database management theory and practice.  Good knowledge of modern technologies such as JDBC, XML, and Web Services APIs.  Strong technical knowledge in modern architectures.  Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.  Active listener.  Lots of curiosity. You never stop learning new things.  Creativity. We love to be surprised with innovative solutions.  Willingness to travel.  Be a team worker with a positive attitude.    We value   Experience working with GIT or other version control systems.  Experience working with relational, NoSQL, and graph databases.  Experience working with data in Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure), including dbPaaS vendors (Snowflake, MongoDB Atlas, etc.).  Experience working with container and orchestration tools (Docker and Kubernetes).  Experience with caching approaches and technologies.  Experience in Windows & Linux (and UNIX) operating systems in server environments.  Business software implementation and integration projects (e.g. ETL/Data Warehouse architectures, CEP, BPM).  Integration with packaged applications (e.g. relational databases, SAP, Siebel, Oracle Financials, Business Intelligence tools,…).  Industry experience in supporting mission‑critical software components.  Experience in attending customer meetings and writing technical documentation.  Foreign language skills are a strong plus: Spanish, French, German…    Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level  Employment type: Full‑time  Job function: Information Technology  Industries: Software Development  Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Denodo by 2x   #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Gerente de Negócios - Data Center em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A Seal é uma empresa com mais de 30 anos de história, sendo a maior integradora de soluções de mobilidade do Brasil, atuando no mercado de computação móvel e captura automática de dados, dando suporte à construção de uma relação de confiança entre usuário final e mais de 2.000 empresas que integram a sua carteira de clientes dentro e fora do Brasil. As a Staff Automation Engineer, you will help us meet this challenge by driving the strategy towards comprehensive automation coverage for features and releases. You will work directly with the product engineering team to develop and maintain our test tools, write and test product code, participate in design reviews to architect testable systems, and guide designs and code to enhance modularity and testability.  You are eager to understand complex systems top to bottom and thrive working across technologies and codebases. In addition, you excel at working through ambiguity, concept validation, and implementing best-in-class solutions. We strive to ensure that our product and support workflows deliver a seamless experience for guests, hosts, and support agents. Lead building, maintaining, and effective utilization of automated tests, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure robust test coverage for features and releases, and actively participating in the continuous improvement of testing processes.  Contribute to improving existing automation frameworks to support new functionalities and optimize quality and efficiency.  Collaborate with CI/CD team to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, ensuring thorough test coverage at every stage of development.  Demonstrate excellent troubleshooting abilities, isolate issues, and verify bug fixes. Debug issues found during testing and after release.  Be a player of our high-performance team to ensure code quality, commitment to craft and operational excellence  Drive collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product management, development, and other QE teams, in a fast-paced environment with short release cycles.    Your Expertise:   9+ years of industry experience in software testing and automation  Demonstrable knowledge in at least one programming language (e.g., Kotlin, Java) and strong scripting skills  Strong knowledge of test automation methodologies, tools, and frameworks  Strong hands‑on experience with automation frameworks (e.g., Espresso)  Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Buildkite, Spinnaker, Jenkins) and version control systems (Git)  Excellent communication skills towards facilitating interactions with cross‑functional teams  Expertise developing solutions to ambiguous problems, and integrations across multiple teams with significant impact  Bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent  Fluency in English (reading, writing, and speaking) is essential. About The Company  If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.  If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey. We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay). To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more. Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.  The Team/role  The Integration Manager acts as the key bridge between business and technical teams, leading the design and governance of system integrations that enable seamless collaboration between merchants, partners, and internal platforms. This role ensures technical scalability, commercial alignment, and cross‑functional coordination to deliver integrations that create measurable business impact.  In this role, you'll be...   Lead the planning, coordination, and implementation of complex system integrations between internal platforms and external partners.  Work closely with Sales, Product, Tech, and Operations to prioritize integration pipelines and ensure alignment with commercial goals.  Define integration standards, documentation, and best practices to ensure scalability and reliability.  Evaluate new partners’ technical feasibility, design integration architecture, and support business case validation.  Supervise and mentor Integration Analysts (D5/D6), ensuring timely execution and adherence to SLAs.  Manage technical governance of integrations, including change control, versioning, and communication with stakeholders.  Track and report integration performance metrics (stability, response times, coverage, and partner satisfaction).  Act as the primary liaison with global Product and R&D teams, aligning local needs with system capabilities and roadmap.  Identify opportunities to optimize existing integrations and support scalable productization of custom solutions.    We're eager to be in touch because you have...   5+ years of experience in system integration, solution engineering, or technical project management.  Strong understanding of API ecosystems (REST, Webhooks, OAuth2, JSON/XML) and integration frameworks.  Proven experience managing cross‑functional projects with business and technical stakeholders.  Strategic and analytical mindset, able to connect technical design with business outcomes.  Experience in e‑commerce, marketplace, or SaaS environments is highly desirable.  Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, including with global teams.  Fluency in Portuguese and English; Mandarin is a strong plus.  Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Business Administration (post‑graduate studies preferred).  Hands‑on familiarity with CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), ERPs, or e‑commerce systems.  Demonstrated ability to coach and coordinate technical contributors while maintaining strong delivery focus.    You'll love working at DiDi because...  We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.  We are data‑driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data‑driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.  Win‑win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.  We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.  Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.  Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.  Diversity & Inclusion  Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us. We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD). vagas.title: Implementation Engineer
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Implementation Engineer em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.  For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.  Implementation Engineer  Adyen is looking for an Implementation Engineer with a solid understanding of and hands‑on experience with technology, integration design, project management and a strong merchant focus. As an implementation consultant, you will be the primary point of contact for our merchant's technical teams, guiding them through the design, development, testing, and launch phases of their integrations with Adyen's platform. Your focus will be on ensuring an exceptional merchant experience throughout the project lifecycle.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on diverse projects that encompass various payment solutions, including e‑commerce platforms, marketplaces, and card issuing programs. By leveraging your technical proficiency and business acumen, you will play a vital role in guaranteeing a smooth implementation process and maintaining open lines of communication with our merchants and internal teams. This position is based in our Brazil office, and the ideal candidate is both consultative and technical.  What you’ll do:   Utilize development and programming expertise to create scalable and robust solutions for merchant integrations, while ensuring adherence to payment best practices.  Serve as a consultative partner in specific verticals such as e‑commerce, point of sale, and multi‑faceted platforms, guiding merchants through integration processes.  Collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Account Managers, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver seamless merchant experiences and drive continuous improvements.  Leverage project management and technical consulting skills to oversee high‑quality project delivery, guaranteeing the technical integrity of merchant integrations.  Provide consultation on optimizing payment solutions, including checkout experiences, authentication, omni‑channel payments, and platform onboarding, while collaborating with Developers and Product Managers to enhance the platform.    Who you are:   C1 level proficiency in Portuguese and English is required for this position.  5+ years of technical consultative experience, providing guidance and recommendations for clients integrating Web API solutions. Experience in payments is a plus.  Proven ability to quickly learn new technologies, understand complex systems (APIs, databases, SDK's, etc.), and desire to improve technical acumen.  Excellent communication skills; comfortable leading discussion with different audiences, e.g. development team, non‑technical stakeholders and leadership.  Ability to understand how different systems work together within a larger software environment. This includes in-depth knowledge and debugging of REST or similar API protocols.    Check out what our implementation teams have to say about their roles here and here.  Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments  Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.  Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!  What’s next?  Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.  This role is based out of our São Paolo  office. We are an office‑first company and value in‑person collaboration; we do not  offer remote‑only roles.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera. Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.  Todos as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Atuar como consultor técnico na elaboração de estudos de impacto ambiental positivo, identificando e propondo soluções que visam a eliminação de desperdício, o aproveitamento racional dos recursos naturais, com foco em água, carbono e energia e resíduos; vagas.title: Technical Account Manager | LATAM
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Account Manager | LATAM em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa. About AB InBev Growth Group  Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world. In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft. We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities. We are implementing BEES systems with strategic partner companies across LATAM and are looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM)  to lead technical strategies, manage complex implementation projects, and act as the key connector between commercial, technical, and operational teams. This role combines project management (PMO), technical ownership, and stakeholder management, ensuring successful end-to-end implementations and long-term partner success. What you’ll do:  Ensure the right product and service are delivered to partners on time and according to commercial agreements. Act as the technical owner of assigned accounts , working closely with the Key Account Manager (KAM). Support partners and internal teams on technical topics, escalating and coordinating with internal stakeholders when needed. Lead and manage implementation projects end-to-end , including timelines, priorities, dependencies, and risks. Monitor product performance and partner adoption, ensuring usage of best-in-class versions and tools. Track the full customer journey, from order status to daily ticket volume and operational performance. Manage post‑go‑live support, ensuring client sustainability through defined success KPIs and action plans. Translate commercial needs into technical requirements, serving as a bridge between business and technology. Build and maintain project documentation and governance.  What you’ll need:  Proven experience in Project Management , Technical Account Management, TPM, or system implementation roles. Background in consulting, SaaS platforms, or system implementations.  Strong problem‑solving skills and customer‑centric mindset. Ability to manage stakeholders with flexibility, influence, and resilience. Comfort working in dynamic environments with high delivery expectations. Advanced communication skills in English  (written and spoken). Spanish at an advanced level (mandatory).  100% availability to travel is required.   Key challenges of the role:  Acting as a PMO , owning project schedules and holding stakeholders accountable to agreed timelines. Working under delivery pressure in complex, cross‑functional environments. Driving partner engagement and internal alignment after go‑live through KPIs, action plans, and commercial demands.  More about you:  You’re proactive, dynamic, and highly organized. Think end‑to‑end, understanding both technical workflows and commercial impact. Thrive in client‑facing roles and enjoy building long‑term partnerships. See yourself as a connector between teams, systems, and business goals. You’re motivated by growth opportunities, international exposure, and real business impact.  What we offer:  Performance based bonus* Attendance Bonus* Casual office and dress code Days off* Health, dental, and life insurance Discounts on Ambev products* School materials assurance Language and training platforms  ABInBev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Engineering the future of logistics – from Brazil to the world  This role is part of our commitment to increase the representation of women in technology at DoorDash Brazil. We strongly encourage candidates who identify as women to apply.  We are building an engineering team where women have equitable access to opportunity, leadership, and long‑term career growth within our São Paulo hub.  At DoorDash, we believe diverse teams build better products. This opportunity is designed to create greater equity in access to engineering roles and long‑term career growth within our São Paulo engineering hub.  DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on‑demand logistics platform. As part of our global expansion, we are investing heavily in Brazil and growing our engineering presence in São Paulo. This is a unique opportunity to join one of Silicon Valley’s fastest‑growing companies—while staying close to home.  We’re looking for Backend Engineers who are excited to solve real‑world problems at scale. You’ll work on product teams or platform teams that power our three‑sided marketplace of Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants . From improving restaurant discovery to optimizing delivery logistics, you’ll help shape the experience of millions of users.  You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers—many based in the U.S.—so fluency in English and strong collaboration skills are essential.  What you’ll do   Design, build, and maintain large‑scale backend systems used by millions of users  Contribute to our technical roadmap and define the architecture for key product areas  Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability, and security  Help transition parts of our monolithic codebase to a microservices architecture  Collaborate with cross‑functional teams across Brazil and the U.S.  Work on high‑impact features that directly improve the user experience for Dashers, Merchants, or Consumers    We’re excited about you because…   You have 1+ years of experience with backend technologies and distributed systems  You're comfortable with modern web architecture (HTTP, REST APIs, gRPC, microservices)  You've worked with relational and non‑relational databases  You enjoy solving complex problems with elegant code and clear thinking  You're fluent in English and confident participating in meetings and code reviews in English  You care about quality and write tests to ensure your code works as expected  You take ownership and enjoy working with autonomy in a fast‑paced environment    Nice to haves   Experience working at a tech company with scale  Familiarity with Java, Kotlin, or similar JVM languages  Exposure to big data technologies or event‑driven architecture  Interest in mentorship or growing into a technical leadership role    Why join DoorDash Brazil?   Work on a global product, with real impact on millions of people  Be part of a fast‑growing engineering hub in São Paulo  Hybrid remote model with great office space in Av. Paulista  English immersion and opportunities to grow your international career  Contribute to a modern, scalable platform used across multiple countries  Build the future of local commerce with a team that values ownership, humility, and getting 1% better every day  Be part of a growing engineering organization committed to building inclusive teams and equitable opportunities    Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only  We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door‑to‑door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We’re committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well‑being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.  Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion  We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, adquirência, processamento e tecnologias para meios de pagamento, contribuindo para a digitalização de instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs. Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros. Requisitos e responsabilidades A equipe de Equity Electronic Trading Automation está procurando um forte programador Java / Engenheiro de Automação para se juntar ao nosso time em crescimento. O candidato contribuirá para o nosso framework baseado em Cucumber/Java/Groovy, ampliando a cobertura de automação existente e mantendo scripts atuais em Unix/Perl/Python. Ele/ela trabalhará com os responsáveis pelas aplicações para entender os requisitos, desenvolver planos de teste, criar testes automatizados e fornecer suporte de negócios para o ambiente de testes. Habilidades Obrigatórias  Engenheiro de garantia de qualidade experiente, com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e sólido entendimento dos fundamentos de testes de software. Profissional com grande foco em resultados, boas habilidades interpessoais e capacidade de trabalhar tanto de forma independente quanto em equipe. Capacidade de compreender sistemas de negociação complexos e desenvolver ferramentas para testá-los. Elevar continuamente o nível das práticas de QA, estabelecendo e documentando procedimentos. Estar atualizado com as mais recentes tecnologias, tanto na empresa quanto no setor, e ser capaz de utilizá-las de forma eficaz. Capacidade de influenciar os membros da equipe a adotar as melhores práticas. Graduação ou pós-graduação em Ciência da Computação ou área técnica similar. Experiência prática na criação e elaboração de casos de teste, incluindo conhecimento de metodologias de teste. Experiência em automação de testes de back-end, incluindo desenvolvimento de framework de automação. Sólido conhecimento de Java core. Experiência em Unix shell scripting. 5 ou mais anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software ou automação de testes. Sólido conhecimento do protocolo FIX e do negócio de equity trading nos EUA.  Habilidades Desejáveis  Experiência com frameworks de teste unitário/mock (ex.: JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, Cucumber etc). Experiência com controle de versão (GIT). Conhecimento em Cucumber, JIRA, TeamCity, Gradle, Ansible. Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis/Scrum.  Benefícios Vale-refeição ou alimentação Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Benefícios flexíveis (Flash) Gympass e TotalPass para cuidar da sua saúde Horários flexíveis  Diversidade e inclusão Aqui na Sinqia, a diversidade é valorizada! Acreditamos que diferentes ideias e pontos de vista tornam nosso time ainda mais forte. Por isso, raça, cor, religião, gênero, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência ou idade não são barreiras para você fazer parte do nosso time. Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.  Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.    Mas espera, ainda tem mais! SOBRE NÓS   A SplitC é uma empresa de especializada na automação de cálculos de comissão/remuneração variável. Nosso propósito é ajudar organizações a eliminar a complexidade de comissões, bônus e incentivos, substituindo planilhas manuais por um processo ágil, preciso e rastreável. Gostamos de entender propósitos e metas para criar produtos que resolvam os reais problemas que impedem o crescimento dos nossos clientes.  Nosso Time   Somos jovens empreendedores que querem inovar e criar as melhores soluções para os nossos clientes. Contamos com um time com imenso conhecimento técnico.  Conheça a SplitC em 3 minutos   Platform Engineer   O que esperamos de você    Conhecimento avançado de Kubernetes (Ex: Helm, Ingress controller, pv pvc, scaling, controllers)  Ferramentas de observabilidade (Ex: Grafana, Prometheus, Opentelemetry)  Terraform  FluxCD  Infra as code  GCP  AWS (S3, AIM)  Airbyte  Entendimento de soluções de FinOps (Diferencial, não essencial)    Principais responsabilidades    Gerenciar e evoluir o ambiente em nuvem (AWS e GCP), mantendo a infraestrutura como código (Kubernetes, Terraform, FluxCD).  Monitorar e garantir a confiabilidade dos serviços, implementando e mantendo dashboards, métricas e alertas (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).  Criar e manter automações para ambientes efêmeros, padronização de notebooks e melhorias no pipeline de CI/CD (com foco em migração e economia de custos).  Atualizar e manter softwares open source internos (Chatwoot, Metabase, Airbyte), garantindo segurança, performance e continuidade das integrações.  Atuar em práticas de FinOps, monitorando custos de cloud, propondo otimizações e configurando alertas automáticos para evitar desperdícios.  Apoiar o time de engenharia no diagnóstico de problemas de ambiente, ajudando devs a entender e resolver incidentes com autonomia.  Padronizar e documentar processos de deploy, monitoramento e manutenção de ambientes.  Dar suporte à evolução de práticas de segurança e compliance, incluindo preparação para certificações como SOC2.    Foco de entrega nos primeiros meses:   Criar automação de ambientes efêmeros.  Implementar alertas de monitoramento e de custo.  Atualizar e otimizar o uso do Airbyte e outros componentes críticos.  Aumentar visibilidade do cluster Kubernetes (uso, nós, pods, custos).  Revisar e padronizar pipelines de CI/CD, reduzindo dependência de ferramentas externas e custos operacionais.    Seu papel no time   Essa pessoa será responsável por assumir a frente operacional e evolutiva da infraestrutura, hoje concentrada no CTO, garantindo estabilidade, eficiência de custos e observabilidade dos sistemas.  Trata-se de um papel mão na massa, com alto grau de autonomia técnica, próxima aos times de engenharia quando necessário.  O que valorizamos:    ️ Soluções boas > soluções perfeitas - execução rápida;      Conhecimento técnico e aprendizagem rápida;  😎 Auto responsabilidade;  🫶 Mentalidade colaborativa (trabalho em equipe, construir juntos e melhorar sempre);  O que oferecemos:     Remoto;    PJ;  🧡 Plano de saúde e odontológico;  🫀 Conexa Saúde;   ️ Wellhub;    Oportunidade de entrar bem no comecinho de uma empresa com um nível empolgante de crescimento;   ️ Abertura dos números da empresa. Semanalmente compartilhamos os resultados com todo mundo! Você aprende a empreender com a gente.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Nova oportunidade para [Fully Remote] Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, React, TypeScript) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Overview  (Fully Remote) Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, React, TypeScript)  Oleve is building a family of iconic consumer software products that enable everyone to live a better, more fulfilling, and more productive life. We’re a small, focused team in NYC who’ve cracked the code on building and scaling products people actually want. We serve over 7M+ users globally.  Role Description  This is a fully remote contract role for a Full-Stack Software Engineer at Oleve, particularly those with strong backend and infrastructure skills. The Full-Stack Software Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining web applications. Tasks include back-end web development using Python and FastAPI and front-end development using React and TypeScript. Additionally, the engineer will work with MongoDB databases and apply CSS for styling user interfaces. The engineer will also be involved in full-stack development activities, including participating in code reviews, debugging, and optimizing performance. You’ll leap into action when critical bugs or incidents arise, building, scaling, and maintaining large-scale distributed systems to ensure problems are resolved before they affect our rapidly growing user base. If you’re energized by solving puzzles and untangling complex technical challenges—and love the thrill of knowing your work directly impacts people around the globe—you’ll thrive in this role.  Responsibilities   Design, develop, and maintain web applications using Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, React, and TypeScript.  Back-end development with Python/FastAPI; front-end with React/TypeScript; integrate CSS for styling.  Participate in code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization.  Respond to critical bugs or incidents; build, scale, and maintain large-scale distributed systems to ensure reliability for a global user base.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to architecture decisions.    Qualifications   Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and database design principles; good UX fundamentals.  Experience deploying to cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google).  Proficient with Git and agile methodologies.  Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).  Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and ability to create pixel-perfect UIs.  Bonus: Prior startup experience or willingness to take on multiple roles.  Preferred: Prior exposure to data orchestration systems and distributed systems.    What We Offer   More ownership and autonomy than anywhere else you've worked before  Flexible fully remote work arrangements and competitive contract compensation  Company retreats at exciting locations worldwide with visa support  Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge infrastructure impacting millions of users  Collaborative, close-knit team building iconic software for the world    Seniority level  Mid-Senior level  Employment type  Contract  Job function  Engineering and Information Technology  Industries  Technology, Information and Internet  Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Oleve by 2x   #J-18808-Ljbffr

We also ensure that our systems are self‑healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state‑of‑the‑art languages like React, Redux state management, Javascript, Kotlin, Scala, data technologies like Kafka, Aerospike and Big Data, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or innovating on the latest fintech idea or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of our Engineering team. Cuidar, juntamente com o escritório externo de contabilidade, da elaboração da Folha de Pagamentos, bem como fazer toda a gestão de guias e pagamentos de encargos sociais da organização. vagas.title: PSE/PSI - Desenvolvedor PL. - IA
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para PSE/PSI - Desenvolvedor PL. - IA em ponta grossa. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Você é uma pessoa curiosa, apaixonada por tecnologia e quer estar na linha de frente do uso de IA generativa aplicada a produtos reais?  Estamos procurando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno  para atuar na área de IA , atuando com AWS Bedrock, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e Large Language Models (LLMs).  Se você quer trabalhar com soluções de ponta, desenvolver agentes inteligentes e participar da criação de ferramentas que transformam o uso de dados e documentos com IA, essa vaga é para você.  Responsabilidades:   Desenvolver e integrar soluções com modelos de linguagem (LLMs) usando AWS Bedrock.  Implementar pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), conectando fontes de dados estruturadas e não estruturadas.  Construir e otimizar agentes inteligentes, capazes de compreender e classificar dados complexos (ex: peças jurídicas, documentos, imagens, etc.).  Criar e manter APIs e microserviços que consumam modelos de IA generativa. Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis e seguras na AWS, garantindo desempenho e custo-benefício.  Desenvolver testes automatizados para validar a performance e precisão dos modelos e integrações.  Realizar ajustes e deploys em ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção.  Colaborar com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de machine learning, traduzindo necessidades em soluções técnicas.  Acompanhar métricas e resultados, sugerindo melhorias e novos caminhos técnicos.  Pesquisar e propor ferramentas, frameworks e estratégias que aprimorem o ciclo de desenvolvimento de IA generativa.    Requisitos (Conhecimentos Técnicos):   Experiência com AWS Bedrock e os principais modelos fundacionais (Claude, Titan, Llama, Mistral, etc.).  Conhecimento em arquiteturas de RAG (indexação, embeddings, vetorização, recuperação e contextualização de prompts).  Domínio de pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python, Node.js, ou outra relevante para IA e backend).  Familiaridade com frameworks de IA generativa (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, etc.).  Conhecimento em serviços AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, API Gateway, ECS ou Step Functions).  Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e metodologias ágeis.  Capacidade de criar e manter testes automatizados e monitoramento de aplicações.  Entendimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.  Conhecimento em integração de APIs REST e boas práticas de segurança.  Capacidade de traduzir regras de negócio em fluxos técnicos e vice-versa.    Perfil Comportamental:   Curiosidade e Aprendizado Contínuo:  Acompanhar o avanço da IA generativa é essencial. Experiência com metodologias de Modelagem de Ameaças (ex: STRIDE).  Familiaridade com o conceito de SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) e o uso de catálogos de serviços (Backstage). Mentalidade de engenharia e solução de problemas complexos (capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas).  Autonomia técnica, iniciativa e postura consultiva.  Senso de urgência e responsabilidade.  Boa capacidade de articulação com times multidisciplinares (Infraestrutura, Foundation, Governança de SI, Engenharias).  Ser pragmático(a) equilibrando a postura de segurança com a velocidade do desenvolvimento e a simplicidade operacional.  Pensamento sistêmico em redução de riscos. Diferenciais:    Experiência prévia como Desenvolvedor (a) de Software, especialmente com Java e/ou .NET.  Familiaridade com ambientes AWS, e com infraestrutura como código (Terraform).  Certificações em segurança (ex.: CISSP, GCIH, GCED, OSCP). Overview Werken bij de brandweer naast je huidige baan of andere bezigheden? Dat kan! Honderden brandweermannen en -vrouwen in de regio combineren het zijn van brandweervrijwilliger met hun werk of studie. Het vrijwilligerswerk brengt actie, uitdaging en afwisseling in je leven. Je staat klaar voor je buren, je dorp of stad. Niet alleen bij brand, maar ook bij (ernstige) verkeersongevallen, stormschade, het redden van dieren en ongelukken met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat is waar jij voor staat! Wie zijn wij? Brandweer Gelderland-Zuid (onderdeel van Veiligheidsregio Gelderland-Zuid) verzorgt met ongeveer 800 brandweervrijwilligers, ruim 200 beroepsmedewerkers verspreid over 36 brandweerposten de brandweerzorg binnen de gehele regio en wanneer nodig ondersteunen we ook daarbuiten. Brandweer Gelderland-Zuid is een organisatie die ruimte biedt aan iedereen. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. Wie ben jij? Je hebt zeker geen alledaagse hobby als je vrijwilliger bij de brandweer bent. Er wordt heel wat van je gevraagd. Je moet kunnen werken onder moeilijke en onverwachte omstandigheden. Als vrijwilliger doe je het werk als brandweerman/-vrouw naast je privéleven en dagelijkse werk. Dit moet dus goed te combineren zijn. Daarbij is afstemming met het thuisfront en werkgever erg belangrijk. Wat ga je doen? Als vrijwillig brandweerman/-vrouw houd je je bezig met brandbestrijding en hulpverlening. De brandweer rukt uit als er brand is, maar we doen veel meer! Een ongeluk waarbij gevaarlijke stoffen vrijkomen, mensen die vastzitten in een lift, een auto die in het water ligt of mensen die bekneld zitten in hun auto na een ongeval. In alle gevallen bieden wij hulp, maar ook als er dieren in benarde situaties verzeild zijn geraakt komen wij helpen. Kortom, de brandweer is er voor alle vormen van hulpverlening, dag en nacht. Dit maakt jouw werk bij de brandweer afwisselend en spannend. Opleiding De leergang Manschap A duurt twee jaar, waarbij je één avond in de week (praktijk) lessen volgt. Verder oefen je één keer in de week met je collega’s van de post. Daarnaast maak je onder begeleiding opdrachten waarmee je je portfolio vult. Je sluit je leergang af met examens. Bekijk voor meer informatie over de leergang het filmpje op deze site ‘Leergang manschap in beeld’. Vergoeding Als brandweervrijwilliger ontvang je een vergoeding voor je inzet. Naast de vaste maandelijkse vergoeding ontvang je een uurvergoeding voor uitrukken, cursussen, oefeningen en overige werkzaamheden. De uurvergoeding hangt af van het soort activiteit en van je functie. Interesse of vragen? Mail dan naar John van den Berg,  , dan wordt er zo snel mogelijk contact met je opgenomen!
